You’ll play a hands-on role in implementing NetSuite, helping translate the company’s finance and payroll needs into clear system requirements and reliable workflows. You’ll also support day-to-day financial operations as the business transitions to the system.

Work with company leadership and implementation partners to understand finance and payroll requirements and translate them into NetSuite workflows

Recommend practical approaches to NetSuite processes and explain options clearly to colleagues who are less familiar with the system

Test accounting workflows and reports, document issues, and follow through on resolutions

Support month-end close and prepare financial reports and supporting schedules



Prepare or review payroll inputs, follow up on discrepancies, and reconcile payroll-related transactions to the general ledger



Create and maintain NetSuite saved searches, reports, and dashboards



Troubleshoot NetSuite transaction and workflow issues, coordinating with implementation partners when needed



Document procedures and help colleagues use NetSuite effectively



Provide clear progress updates, flag obstacles early, and keep implementation tasks moving



Protect confidential financial, company, and employee information

At least three years of relevant accounting or finance operations experience, including reconciliations, journal entries, and month-end close



Advanced, hands-on NetSuite proficiency, with substantial experience using its core accounting and finance functions



Direct involvement in at least one NetSuite implementation or migration, with meaningful responsibility for requirements, system setup, data preparation, validation, testing, or launch support



Ability to explain your personal contribution to a previous NetSuite implementation and the problems you helped resolve



Ability to work independently in NetSuite, investigate transaction discrepancies, troubleshoot workflow issues, and produce accurate reports



Strong working knowledge of NetSuite saved searches, financial reporting, CSV imports, and dashboards



Strong understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, the general ledger, and financial statements



Practical payroll experience, including reviewing payroll information, resolving discrepancies, and reconciling payroll entries



Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciling information across multiple files or reports



Excellent written and spoken English



Ability to explain financial and system issues clearly, recommend solutions, and communicate confidently with a U.S.-based team



Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through



Ability to manage recurring finance deadlines alongside implementation tasks



Reliable internet and a quiet, private workspace



Availability to work the full U.S. Eastern Time schedule listed below



Applicants must bring established NetSuite expertise and hands-on implementation experience. Experience limited to basic data entry or viewing reports is not sufficient for this role.



Preferred Qualifications:



Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field



Previous experience supporting U.S.-based businesses



Experience configuring NetSuite finance workflows and supporting user acceptance testing



Experience reconciling financial information between a previous accounting system and NetSuite



Familiarity with U.S. payroll processes and payroll platforms



Experience documenting financial procedures and training colleagues



Relevant accounting qualification or NetSuite certification



Work Setup:



Full-time, permanent remote position; Philippines-based candidates only



Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–6 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time



Eight working hours per day, with one hour of breaks throughout the day; 40 working hours per week



Schedule follows U.S. Eastern Time, including daylight saving changes



Target start date within two weeks



All confidential financial and employee information must remain within approved company systems



Who We’re Looking For:



Someone who knows NetSuite well and brings equally strong finance skills. You understand how transactions flow through the accounts, can recognize when a balance is incorrect, and know how to investigate and resolve the issue.



You’ve helped a business implement NetSuite and can explain what worked, what needed attention, and how you contributed. You’re comfortable guiding colleagues, asking the right questions, and turning business needs into practical processes.



You take ownership, communicate early, and follow through without repeated reminders. We’re looking for a dependable professional who can become a trusted, long-term member of the team.



How to Apply:

How long have you used NetSuite, and which accounting and finance functions have you personally handled?

What is your earliest available start date, and can you work the listed schedule?



Please ensure your résumé clearly shows your NetSuite implementation experience and the finance and payroll responsibilities you have personally handled.



SKILL REQUIREMENT



NetSuite | NetSuite Implementation | Accounting & Finance | Payroll | Microsoft Excel

title: Technical Apparel Designer
description:
About the role:



Rapid Hockey is looking for a freelance technical apparel designer to build the patterns, 3D samples, and tech packs behind our custom team uniforms. This is an ongoing, project-based role: each time we develop a new style, you'll be our first call.



Rapid Hockey (also known as Rapid Athletic) makes fully custom hockey uniforms, including jerseys, socks, and related apparel, for teams and programs. We're building out our product documentation so any qualified factory can produce our garments to the same standard. Your work will become the master blueprint for every style we make.



What you'll do:



You'll take each style from concept or existing sample to a factory-ready package.

1. Pattern making. Create production patterns for new styles, and reverse engineer patterns from our existing garments where we don't have files. Grade patterns across our full youth through adult size range.

2. 3D development in CLO 3D. Build each style as a 3D garment to check fit, proportions, and decoration placement before we cut a physical sample.

3. Tech packs. Produce complete tech packs for each base style: bill of materials, fabric and trim specs, construction and stitching details, graded measurement charts, and decoration specs for sublimation and tackle twill.

4. Factory handoff support. Answer factory questions, review samples against spec, and update files when we make changes.



To start, we'll document our two or three best-selling styles out of about 10 base styles, then work through the rest over time.



What we're looking for:

Required

• 3+ years of technical design or pattern making experience in apparel

• Strong working knowledge of CLO 3D, with a portfolio showing 3D garments you built

• Experience creating full tech packs that factories have produced from

• Pattern grading across a wide size range

• Ability to reverse engineer patterns and specs from finished garments

• Clear written English and reliable communication across time zones

Nice to have

• Experience with team sports or athletic uniforms, especially hockey jerseys and socks

• Knowledge of sublimation, tackle twill, and performance knit fabrics

• Experience working directly with overseas factories

• Familiarity with Techpacker or similar tech pack software



Engagement and how to apply:

• Type: Freelance, ongoing, project-based

• Location: Remote

• Pay: $4/hour

• Ownership: All patterns, CLO files, and tech packs created are owned by Rapid Hockey and delivered in editable source formats



To apply, send:

1. Your portfolio, including at least one CLO 3D garment and one complete tech pack

2. Confirmation that $4/hour works for you, and your typical hours per style

3. A short note on any team sports or athletic apparel you've worked on

title: Prior Authorization Specialist
description:
Position Summary

We're looking for someone who combines exceptional organization with exceptional people skills. You'll be responsible for keeping insurance authorizations moving, tracking down critical documentation, and building strong relationships with the physician offices and referral partners we work with every day. Success in this role means taking ownership, anticipating problems, and following through until the job gets done. 



Core Responsibilities

Insurance Authorizations & Tracking

-Prepare and submit initial and ongoing insurance authorization requests, ensuring all required documentation is complete and accurate.

-Monitor pending authorizations, check for approvals, and proactively follow up with insurance companies.

-Maintain accurate authorization records, including approved dates, units, and supporting documentation.

-Identify upcoming authorization expirations and help prevent interruptions in patient care.

-Escalate complex authorization issues, denials, or discrepancies to the Insurance Specialist.



Physician Office & Referral Partner Communication

-Contact physician offices and referring clinics by phone, fax, and
 to obtain signed plans of care and other required documentation.

-Develop strong, lasting relationships with physician offices and referral partners, becoming a trusted, dependable contact who makes it easy for their teams to work with TeamUp Therapy. 

-Follow up persistently and respectfully on outstanding requests, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

-Maintain organized records of outreach attempts, responses, and next steps.



Documentation, Audits & Organization

-Upload and organize authorization approvals, signed plans of care, and other insurance documents in our electronic medical record system.

-Maintain and update authorization tracking spreadsheets and patient hold records.

-Conduct routine authorization audits to identify missing documentation, upcoming deadlines, or potential issues.

-Communicate proactively with the Insurance Specialist and clinical team regarding authorization status, delays, and outstanding needs.



Additional Administrative Support

-Cross-train on key intake and scheduling responsibilities to provide backup coverage when needed.

-Help identify opportunities to improve workflows, efficiency, and the overall patient experience.



Must-Have Skills & Experience

-Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with confidence and professionalism on phone calls.

-Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.

-Strong relationship-building skills, with a warm, personable, and persistent communication style.

-Ability to work independently, take initiative, and consistently follow through on tasks.

-Strong computer skills and comfort using Google Sheets, Docs, and other web-based platforms.

-Willingness to learn new systems, adapt to changing processes, and take on additional responsibilities.

-Experience working remotely with a reliable internet connection and professional work environment.



Preferred Qualifications

-Previous experience managing U.S. healthcare prior authorizations is strongly preferred, particularly in pediatric speech, occupational, or physical therapy. 

-Familiarity with electronic medical records, insurance portals, or healthcare practice management software.

-Experience communicating with physician offices, referral partners, or insurance companies.

-Spanish fluency is a plus.



Schedule & Work Environment

-Weekly Hours: 40 hours/week (full-time)

-Work Hours: 9am- 5pm ET, Monday–Friday

-Location: Remote

-Training: Initial onboarding, SOP-based training, and ongoing support from our Insurance Specialist and administrative team



Compensation & Classification

-Type: Independent Contractor

-Hourly Rate: $7.00 USD per hour

-Performance Bonuses: Eligible for quarterly performance bonuses based on individual performance and contributions to team goals



Success Metrics

-Authorization requests are submitted accurately and on time, minimizing interruptions in patient care.

-Outstanding signed plans of care and required documentation are obtained through consistent, proactive follow-up.

-Referral partners and physician offices experience warm, responsive, and professional communication.

-Authorization records, tracking systems, and patient hold lists remain accurate and up to date.

-The broader administrative team receives reliable backup support when needed.



About TeamUp Therapy

TeamUp Therapy is a pediatric telehealth practice providing speech and occupational therapy to families across Georgia. We believe in removing barriers to care—making therapy ultra-convenient, family-centered, and accessible without unnecessary wait times.



Our mission is to help every child reach their full potential through compassionate, high-quality care.



Our team is guided by three core values: Solve Problems, Communicate Clearly, and Empower Families. We're a collaborative, growing organization that values initiative, accountability, and people who genuinely care about making a difference.



Introduction Video (2–3 Minutes)

Please record a short video introducing yourself and answering the following questions:

-Tell us a little about yourself and your professional background.

-What experience do you have with U.S. healthcare, insurance authorizations, or medical administration?

-Why are you interested in joining TeamUp Therapy as our Prior Authorization Specialist?

-We're looking forward to getting to know you! No professional editing or special production is necessary. Please just make sure your audio is clear and that we can see and hear you comfortably.



You can upload either a Google Drive sharing link or a YouTube link. Please submit it through this Google Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe1V4fwel5Ev8CsQOP7_Uh5Rs5nFV3NL4huo2-8CZg7zRpEfQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=113651035607991832792

Are you an expert in video editing/Graphic Designing with a passion for creating dynamic, impactful content? If you have a proven ability to craft compelling narratives through video and are up-to-date with the latest editing techniques, we’d love to hear from you!

About T3 Tech Partners

We deliver advanced Systems Administration, Infrastructure, Networking, Cloud, and Security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.



Our engineers are trusted technical partners. They lead implementations, resolve complex escalations, and work directly with MSP clients to deliver real-world solutions. Our outbound team is the first voice those partners hear, and that first impression matters.



Role Overview



We are looking for an experienced Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to drive outbound prospecting into MSPs and IT firms across the United States. You will own the top of the funnel: working through prospect lists we provide, making high-volume outbound calls, handling objections in real time, and booking qualified discovery meetings for our leadership team.



This is a voice-first role. You will speak every day with US-based business owners, IT directors, and MSP principals, so clear, confident, natural-sounding English is essential. You’ll need to hold a real business conversation with senior decision-makers without relying on a script.



Key Responsibilities



Outbound Calling & Prospecting



Make 80–100 outbound dials per day (after a two-week ramp-up) to MSPs, IT service firms, and internal IT departments across US time zones.

Open conversations confidently with owners, principals, and IT decision-makers.

Qualify prospects against our ideal-client profile (company size, service mix, gaps in Tier 3 coverage).

Handle gatekeepers professionally and consistently reach the decision-maker.

Book qualified discovery calls directly onto the sales calendar.



Objection Handling & Conversation Quality



Respond to objections in real time without reading from a script.

Adapt tone and pacing to the person on the other end of the line.

Explain our value clearly to a technical audience without overstating technical claims.

Recognize when to disqualify a prospect quickly and move on.



Follow-Up & Pipeline Management



Run structured follow-up sequences by phone,
, and LinkedIn.

Log every call, outcome, and next step in Go High Level the same day.

Keep prospect lists clean, correcting bad data as you find it.

Nurture “not right now” prospects on a set callback schedule.



Reporting & Continuous Improvement



Report daily and weekly on dials, connects, conversations, and appointments set.

Join call reviews and act on coaching feedback.

Test and report on messaging, opening lines, and list segments.

Flag recurring objections and market feedback to leadership.

Availability

Working hours are 10:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

This is a night shift in the Philippines. Please apply only if you have worked a graveyard schedule before and can sustain it long term.

Some flexibility may be needed during active campaigns or event-driven outreach.

This role is not on-call, but consistent attendance during US business hours is essential.

What We Provide

Targeted prospect lists of US-based MSPs and IT firms, so your time goes into calling, not researching

A Go High Level account with built-in dialer, phone number, CRM, and direct booking to the sales calendar

Training on our services and ideal-client profile, plus ongoing call coaching

A two-week ramp-up period: your daily target is 50–60 dials while you learn our services and messaging, then moves to the full 80–100

Qualifications



Required



2+ years of outbound cold calling, appointment setting, or SDR experience in the US market.

Clear, confident spoken and written English that US business owners understand easily, with natural pacing and strong phone presence.

Proven ability to hold unscripted business conversations with senior decision-makers.

A track record of hitting dial, conversation, and appointment targets.

Comfortable working in a CRM and dialer platform. Go High Level experience is a strong plus (we provide the account).

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, a backup power source, and a quality noise-cancelling headset.

Comfortable with rejection and high call volume; self-directed with minimal supervision.



Preferred



Outbound experience selling into MSPs, IT services, or B2B technology.

Familiarity with Microsoft 365, cloud, or managed IT terminology.

Hands-on Go High Level experience (calling, pipelines, calendar booking, follow-up workflows).

Experience researching prospects (Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to personalize outreach.

Compensation

Base: $850 USD per month, paid twice monthly.

Appointment commission: $25 USD for every qualified appointment that takes place.

Conversion bonus: $100 USD for every prospect who signs on for services after a meeting you booked.

No minimum threshold. Commission is paid from your first qualified appointment.

Engagement type: Independent contractor. Payment method: bank transfer via Gusto HR system



What counts as a qualified appointment



The meeting must actually take place, and the person on the call must be a decision-maker or decision-influencer: an owner, principal, partner, CEO, CTO, IT director, IT manager, service manager, or operations manager. A help desk technician, receptionist, or office administrator does not count, even if they agreed to the meeting. Our sales team confirms each attendee’s role after the meeting, and you’ll see the result in Go High Level.



Reschedules don’t affect commission. If the meeting eventually happens with a qualifying contact, you are paid. Appointments that never take place are not paid.



Conversion bonus



If a prospect you booked signs a services agreement with T3 Tech Partners within 90 days of the meeting taking place, you receive an extra $100 USD, paid on signature. There is no cap.



What this adds up to



At a normal pace of 15 to 20 held appointments per month, base plus commission comes to $1,225–$1,350. Two signed clients in a month brings that to $1,425–$1,550.



How to Apply – Audio Sample Required



Applications without an audio sample will not be reviewed. It’s the first thing we check.



This role is judged on how you sound on the phone, so please record a 60–90 second voice sample yourself, in your own voice, in one take. Cover:



Your name and where you’re based.

A brief summary of your outbound calling experience and the markets you’ve called into.

A mock cold call opener: you’ve just reached the owner of a US-based MSP who wasn’t expecting your call. Deliver your first 20–30 seconds exactly as you would on a real dial.

How you’d respond if that owner said, “We already have an internal engineer for that.”



How to send it



Record with any free tool, then paste the shareable link into the job post chat here on OnlineJobs.ph. Options that work well:



Vocaroo (
): records in your browser, no account needed, instant link

Voice Spice (
): browser-based recorder with a shareable link

Clyp (
): free hosting with a direct link

Google Drive or Dropbox: record on your phone, upload, and share



Make sure anyone with the link can listen. We can’t chase permission requests, and locked links count as no submission.



In your chat message, please include:



The word Tier3 as the first word of your message (so we know you read the full post)

Your audio link

Your resume or a link to it

The number of outbound dials you typically made per day in your last role

Confirmation that you can work 10:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time, and whether you’ve worked a night shift before



We review every application that includes an audio sample. Strong candidates will be invited to a short live phone screen, where, once again, how you sound matters most.

title: Content Clipper / Editor - Short-Form Social Media
description:
Do you want to work on content that reaches millions of people while being part of a fast-growing transformation and sound healing brand built around community?



Our content averages roughly **50–150 million views per month**, and we're looking for a highly skilled **Short-Form Content Clipper** to join our team full time.



We're expanding our long-form content production and need someone who can turn hours of footage into compelling, high-retention short-form videos for Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



**This is NOT a traditional video editing role.**



We're looking for someone who understands **viral content, the psychology of hooks, storytelling, pacing, and audience retention.**



The most important skill is knowing **what to clip, where to start, what to cut out, and exactly when to end.**



## About Us



Harmony is a fast-growing transformation, music, and sound healing company founded by musician and intuitive guide Banah Winn.



We create Golden Ratio Frequencies, guided experiences, educational content, live events, and an online community dedicated to helping people create meaningful change in their lives.



Our content reaches **50–150 million views per month**, and we're expanding into more long-form videos, live teachings, interviews, music performances, and behind-the-scenes documentaries.



We have an established creative team and a deep understanding of what performs on social media. We're looking for someone who can help us turn our growing library of long-form content into a consistent stream of powerful short-form videos.



## About the Role



Your main responsibility will be to **review long-form footage, independently identify the strongest moments, and turn them into engaging short-form clips.**



You won't always be given timestamps or instructions telling you what to cut. You'll need the judgment to recognize which moments have the highest potential to perform on social media.



Sometimes the best hook is buried in the middle of a conversation. Sometimes removing 20 seconds makes the entire clip more compelling. Sometimes a moment needs to breathe.



**Your ability to make these decisions is the core skill we're hiring for.**



## What You'll Be Clipping



We produce a variety of long-form content, including:



- **Vlogs & Behind-the-Scenes:** Interesting, funny, authentic, and emotional moments that tell a story.

- **Live Teaching & Authority Videos:** Powerful insights, explanations, and breakthroughs from webinars, live calls, and educational sessions.

- **Interviews & Conversations:** Surprising answers, compelling stories, memorable exchanges, and interesting perspectives.

- **Live Music & Performances:** Beautiful, moving, and engaging moments from live musical sessions.

- **Long-Form Talking Videos:** Strong teachings, memorable statements, and valuable explanations.

- **Guest Teachers & Community Calls:** Engaging moments from other guides, teachers, and community members.



Each format requires a different approach to selecting clips, storytelling, and pacing.



## What We're Looking For



- **Excellent understanding of viral hooks:** You know what stops someone from scrolling and how to capture attention in the first few seconds.

- **Strong editorial judgment:** You can identify the most compelling moments and know exactly where to start, what to remove, and when to end a clip.

- **Understanding of retention and pacing:** You recognize when content drags, when to make cuts, and when to let a moment breathe.

- **Excellent English comprehension:** You understand natural conversation, humor, emotion, nuance, and context well enough to recognize powerful moments.

- **Short-form storytelling:** You can turn longer conversations into standalone clips with a clear, engaging structure.

- **Knowledge of viral formats:** You actively study successful social media content and understand what makes different styles perform.

- **Strong editing fundamentals:** Clean cuts, natural dialogue, good audio, and proper vertical formatting.

- **Independence and efficiency:** You can review large amounts of footage, select clips, and deliver them quickly without constant direction.

- **Reliability and communication:** You consistently meet deadlines, communicate clearly, and work effectively within a team.



### Bonus Skills



- On-screen captions and text overlays

- Simple graphics and supporting visuals

- Experience growing social media accounts organically

- Proven clips with significant organic views

- Experience with music, podcasts, interviews, or documentary-style content



## Editing Style



Our style is generally **simple, clean, and native to social media.**



We're not looking for complicated effects, flashy transitions, or heavy motion graphics.



Initially, your focus will be on selecting great moments, making clean cuts, tightening pacing, and creating clips that keep people watching.



On-screen captions and text overlays are not required for every clip initially, but we'd ideally like someone who knows how to add them.



We care much more about **content selection and retention than complicated editing.**



## Speed & Volume



As our long-form production expands, we'll have a significant amount of footage to review.



We need someone who can work efficiently, identify the strongest moments, and consistently deliver high-quality clips.



This is intended to be a **full-time position** with consistent ongoing work and opportunities to grow with the company.



## Pay



**$8/hour**



## To Apply



Please send:



- **3–5 examples of your best short-form clips created from longer content**

- **The number of views each clip received and the platform it was posted on** (Instagram, TikTok,
, or YouTube Shorts)

- Links to the published clips so we can review them

- Your experience clipping long-form content

- Your typical turnaround time

- Your current availability

- Your earliest start date



**Please do not send only cinematic edits, music videos, motion graphics, or scripted talking-head videos.**



We want to see examples that demonstrate your ability to **find compelling moments in longer footage and turn them into engaging short-form content.**

title: AI Animation Video Creator — 3D Cartoon / Pixar-Style Social Media Videos
description:
Do you want to create beautiful AI-animated videos that reach millions of people while being part of a fast-growing music, transformation, and sound healing brand?



Our content averages roughly **50–150 million views per month**, and we're looking for a talented **AI Animation Video Creator** to join our creative team.



We already have successful scripts, voiceovers, and proven social media content. We're looking for someone who can **transform these into engaging, high-quality AI-animated videos** with a Pixar-inspired, 3D cartoon, or cinematic animation style.



**This is not a traditional video editing role.**



We're looking for someone who understands AI animation, visual storytelling, and how to create videos that capture attention and keep people watching.



## About Us



Harmony is a fast-growing transformation, music, and sound healing company founded by musician and intuitive guide Banah Winn.



We create Golden Ratio Frequencies, guided experiences, educational content, live events, and an online community dedicated to helping people create meaningful change in their lives.



Our content reaches **50–150 million views per month** across social media. We have an established creative team and a library of proven, high-performing content that we want to bring to life through animation.



## About the Role



Your main responsibility will be to **take our existing scripts, voiceovers, and winning videos and turn them into compelling AI-animated content** for Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



We'll provide the scripts, audio, and creative references.



Your job is to d
 how to visually bring them to life.



You'll be responsible for:



- Turning existing voiceovers and scripts into fully animated videos

- Creating engaging 3D cartoon characters, scenes, and environments

- Developing visual concepts that illustrate what's being said

- Matching animation timing and scene changes to the voiceover

- Creating strong visual hooks in the opening seconds

- Maintaining character and visual consistency across scenes

- Using expressions, movement, and visual storytelling to bring the message to life

- Editing animated scenes together with voiceovers, music, and sound effects

- Creating multiple visual variations of proven scripts when needed



**The goal is to take content we already know performs and give it a completely new visual format through animation.**



## What We're Looking For



- **Strong AI animation skills:** You can produce beautiful 3D cartoon-style animation using modern AI tools.

- **Visual storytelling:** You know how to translate spoken dialogue into interesting animated scenes rather than simply illustrating every word literally.

- **Understanding of viral content:** You understand hooks, pacing, retention, and what makes animated content engaging on social media.

- **Character consistency:** You can maintain characters, environments, and visual styles across multiple shots.

- **Cinematic animation:** You understand lighting, composition, camera movement, and expressive character animation.

- **Voiceover synchronization:** You know how to time visuals, scene changes, and animations naturally with existing audio.

- **Creative judgment:** You can independently d
 which visuals best support the message.

- **Attention to detail:** You recognize and correct distorted characters, awkward movements, and obvious AI artifacts.

- **Speed and efficiency:** You have a reliable workflow for consistently producing high-quality animated videos.

- **Strong communication:** You're responsive, organized, and comfortable working with feedback and revisions.



## AI Tools & Workflow



You should be experienced with AI image and video generation tools such as:



- Kling

- Runway

- Google Veo

- Sora

- Midjourney

- Nano Banana

- Other professional AI animation tools



We're not attached to any specific software.



**We care about the quality of your finished videos and your ability to produce them consistently.**



## Animation Style



We're particularly interested in:



- Pixar-inspired 3D cartoon animation

- DreamWorks-style animated characters

- Expressive characters and engaging visual storytelling

- Cinematic lighting and imaginative environments

- Colorful, polished, professional-looking animation

- Short-form animation designed specifically for social media



The videos should feel like cohesive animated stories, not a collection of disconnected AI-generated scenes.



## Speed & Volume



We have an existing library of successful scripts and voiceovers, so you won't need to develop every concept from scratch.



We're looking for someone who can efficiently turn these assets into high-quality animated videos while maintaining strong visual consistency and attention to detail.



This is an opportunity for consistent ongoing work and growth with our creative team.

title: Wholesale Real Estate Acquisitions Manager - Seller Calls, Underwriting, Offers
description:
Lineflow is a US real estate wholesaling operation working the Houston and Fort Bend, Texas markets. We are hiring a full time Acquisitions Manager to run the seller side of the business end to end.



How the work flows: our team sends the first outreach text to homeowners. Your job starts the moment a seller replies. From there you own the deal: follow-up, qualification calls, running the numbers, making offers inside clear guardrails, and getting the purchase contract signed. Final contract price approval stays with the owner. Everything else on acquisitions is yours.



What you will do:

- Call sellers back fast: when a seller shows interest during your shift, you call within 1 minute, and never later than 5 minutes. Speed to lead is measured and reported.

- Qualify sellers on live calls: motivation, timeline, property condition, mortgage and listing status, and asking price.

- Underwrite every deal with our formula (training and a calculator provided): Buyer MAO = (ARV x 0.70) minus repairs. Max offer = Buyer MAO minus our target assignment fee minus a safety buffer. You will learn to return a clear pass, renegotiate, or kill verdict on every deal.

- Make offers within the guardrails, handle seller objections, and follow up persistently until the seller signs or is clearly dead.

- Keep the CRM (Morrev) perfectly updated: every call, note, and stage change, every day.

- Support dispositions: match each signed deal to our cash buyer list and help keep buyers warm.

- Send a short daily report: new leads worked, calls made, offers out, contracts signed, and any speed-to-lead misses with reasons.



Requirements:

- You have done acquisitions or seller-facing follow-up for a US real estate wholesaler or investor before. This is a hard requirement.

- Your spoken English is clear and natural on the phone with Texas homeowners. This role lives on live seller calls.

- You can work 8 AM to 5 PM US Central time, Monday to Friday, and you are not splitting this shift with other clients.

- You are comfortable with dialers and CRMs (for example Mojo, SmrtPhone, BatchDialer, Podio, REsimpli, or similar) and you learn new tools fast.

- You are honest with numbers. If a deal does not work at the seller's price, you say so and show the math.



Pay: $600-$800/month depending on experience, paid monthly, plus a bonus for every closed deal from leads you worked. This is a long term role with room to grow as the operation grows.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS (all five required):

1. Start your application with the word PIPELINE. Applications without it are not read.

2. Record a voice introduction of 1 minute or less (use Vocaroo or a similar free tool) and paste the link. Introduce yourself and summarize your acquisitions experience. No voice link, no review.

3. Run this deal and show your math. Houston single family home. ARV $260,000. Repairs $38,000. Seller is asking $190,000. Our formula: Buyer MAO = (ARV x 0.70) minus repairs. Max offer = Buyer MAO minus a $10,000 target assignment fee minus a $5,000 safety buffer. What is the Buyer MAO? What is the most we could offer? Is the seller's asking price workable, and if not, what would you say to the seller?

4. Scenario: a seller replied last week with "Not interested, stop texting me." Today the same seller texts: "Actually, what would you pay for it?" Write exactly what you would do and say, step by step.

5. List the US wholesalers or investors you have done acquisitions or seller follow-up work for, what you did for each, which dialers and CRMs you used, your exact available hours in US Central time, and how fast you commit to calling a seller back when they show interest during your shift.

description:
Greater Phoenix Cleaning

Remote | Philippines | Part-time: 20 hours per week

$4–$6 USD per hour base pay + performance bonuses and commissions

Schedule: Agreed weekday shifts during Phoenix, Arizona business hours. This requires evening/overnight availability in the Philippines. Exact shifts agreed before hiring.



TURN CONVERSATIONS INTO CONTRACT OPPORTUNITIES



You enjoy starting conversations, asking the right questions, and earning the next meeting. You can hear “we already have a cleaner,” stay curious, and find out whether there is a real opportunity. You follow through when others forget.



Greater Phoenix Cleaning is hiring an outbound sales professional to help grow our residential and commercial cleaning business across Greater Phoenix. You will build your own pipeline, book qualified commercial walkthroughs, and develop relationships that lead to repeat business.



Bring initiative, confidence, and a serious appetite to improve. We bring hands-on sales coaching, feedback, and room to grow.



YOUR MISSION



Book at least three qualified commercial cleaning walkthrough appointments per week after onboarding, while building a pipeline of future recurring accounts and referral partnerships.



A qualified walkthrough means a business in our service area has a relevant cleaning need, the decision-maker or authorized contact agrees to a specific appointment, and our team receives accurate contact details and useful notes. Confirm appointments, help reschedule cancellations, and track which meetings actually happen.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Find prospects through free sources such as public business directories, company websites, professional networks, and permitted social media outreach.

- Call business owners, office managers, property managers, and other decision-makers. Learn how they handle cleaning, whether they are satisfied, and whether a free commercial cleaning evaluation would be useful.

- Book walkthroughs and hand off clear notes so our local team can evaluate the property, prepare a quote, and pursue the contract.

- Build relationships with contractors and developers for post-construction cleaning, real estate agents for referrals, and Airbnb hosts and short-term rental managers for recurring turnovers.

- Nurture interested prospects through relevant follow-ups. Keep the CRM current, with a next action and follow-up date for every active opportunity.

- Report conversations, appointments booked and held, and pipeline progress. Suggest improvements and test approved outreach ideas. Respect opt-outs and each platform’s rules.



Commercial walkthroughs are the first priority. Partnership outreach will be planned around that goal within your 20-hour week.



YOU WILL FIT HERE IF YOU



- Have successful outbound calling, appointment-setting, or lead-generation experience with U.S. prospects and can explain your results.

- Have worked with home service businesses or can demonstrate a strong understanding of how they win customers and build trust.

- Speak clear, fluent English that U.S. prospects can easily understand, listen carefully, and write professional follow-ups.

- Build rapport, handle objections, and negotiate next steps confidently without pressuring people or promising unauthorized pricing.

- Enjoy sales, take ownership, handle rejection professionally, and apply coaching to your next conversation.

- Bring strong research, organization, and business communication skills developed through education, training, or relevant experience.

- Have a reliable computer, internet connection, headset, quiet calling environment, and availability for the agreed schedule.



Experience with cleaning services, B2B sales, real estate, construction, short-term rentals, CRM systems, or social media lead generation is a strong advantage.



PAY AND GROWTH



- $4–$6 USD per hour for all hours worked, based on demonstrated skills and experience. Proven social media lead-generation ability will also be considered in the starting rate.

- 20 hours per week initially, with opportunities to increase hours as performance and business needs support it.

- Quarterly hourly raises, with increase amounts tied to performance.

- Additional bonuses and commissions for hitting and exceeding targets; the incentive structure will be agreed in writing before you start.

- Paid training, hands-on sales coaching, and opportunities for greater responsibility.



HOW TO APPLY — ANSWER ALL THREE QUESTIONS



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject “GPC — Pipeline Builder.” Include your relevant work history or résumé and answer each question separately. Aim for 100–150 words per answer. Use your own experience, omit confidential client details, and identify estimates honestly.



1. What outbound results have you personally produced?

Describe your most relevant role, the service you sold, the prospects you contacted, and a specific month or campaign. Include your approximate weekly hours, outreach volume, appointments booked, appointments held, and resulting sales if known. Separate your individual contribution from the team’s results.



2. How have you turned an objection into a useful next step?

Describe a real conversation where a prospect said “we already have someone,” “send me information,” or “your price is too high.” What did you say next, what did you learn, and what happened after your follow-up? Use wording as close to the actual conversation as you can remember.



3. How have you built and nurtured a pipeline without paid leads?

Walk us through a real example: where you found prospects, how you identified the right contact, how you organized follow-ups, and what results you achieved. Explain one improvement you made when the initial approach did not work. If you have always received lead lists, say so and describe the closest relevant experience.



Applications must answer all three questions to be considered for an interview. Specific examples matter more than a polished introduction. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid sales roleplay using a fictional prospect.

title: Customer Success Representative
description:
MISSION STATEMENT



SecureSpace Self Storage is one of the fastest-growing Self Storage platforms in the USA, with assets located primarily in high-density, urban markets. With a focus on exceptional customer service and upgraded security features, SecureSpace provides a high-quality experience that our customers can count on in any store they visit.

The Customer Success Representative at SecureSpace plays a crucial role in building strong relationships with customers by identifying their storage needs and offering tailored solutions using SecureSpace’s proprietary technology. This position involves actively engaging with customers to understand their requirements and challenges while leveraging cutting-edge technology to enhance customer experiences across all facility locations nationwide. The representative will perform all responsibilities from home, allowing flexibility while staying connected with customers and the team. This role thrives in a fast-paced and diverse environment, requiring a proactive and motivated individual excited about contributing to customer satisfaction and success in a technology-driven landscape.

· Assist new customers throughout the rental process and ensure they understand the agreements.



· Function independently daily while promoting teamwork and collaboration with other locations in a remote environment.



· Demonstrate strong consulting, troubleshooting, and adaptability skills to effectively resolve issues as a Customer Success Representative.



· Complete additional duties as assigned.



REPORTS TO: Customer Success Manager



PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:



Qualified individuals must be able to perform the position's essential duties with or without accommodation. A qualified person with a disability may request a modification or adjustment to the job or work environment to meet the physical requirements of the position. GSA/SecureSpace will attempt to satisfy requests if the accommodations needed are reasonable and no undue hardship would result.



· Ability to perform essential job functions while seated for extended periods, including working on a computer and taking phone calls, as well as sit, walk, stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel, and twist intermittently or continuously.



· Capability to read documents and focus on computer screens, with or without corrective lenses as may be required.



· Ability to arrange the workspace efficiently for productivity, accommodating any individual needs for ergonomic considerations.



· Willingness to transition between various tasks and responsibilities while maintaining work efficiency and effectiveness.

title: Creative Brand Strategist and Graphic Designer
description:
40-Hour Project | Immediate Hiring | Deadline: November 23, 2026



Hi! I'm looking for a talented and creative graphic designer to help develop a cohesive visual identity for AIM Atlanta,  an Atlanta-based social events and lifestyle brand.



We bring people together through curated social experiences, networking events, recreational activities, and community gatherings. One of our signature experiences is Pickleball & Mingle.



I'm looking for someone who can create branding that feels modern, elevated, sophisticated, playful, and memorable.



I value originality, thoughtful design, and someone who can bring creative ideas to the table.



 Project Deliverables

- **Logo:** Original, creative logo design

- **Brand Kit:** Color palette, typography, and visual guidelines

- **Website:** One-page landing page design

- **Slide Deck:** Branded presentation template

- **Reel Covers:** Reusable Instagram Reel cover templates

- **Carousels:** Reusable Instagram carousel templates

- **Social Posts:** Reusable branded post templates



All deliverables must include editable source files.



Creative Direction



I'm looking for branding that feels more like a **lifestyle brand than a traditional event-planning company**.



I prefer creative, concept-driven designs rather than literal interpretations of the business. I'm not looking for generic templates or obvious event-related symbols.



**Absolutely no AI-generated logos.** All logo concepts must be original and manually designed. Generative AI should not be used to create the final designs.



How to Apply



I appreciate your time and want to keep the application process simple!



Since I'll be reviewing applications quickly, please keep your response **short and focused**.



Please include:



1. **Three examples of your most relevant work**, preferably branding, logos, or websites for lifestyle, hospitality, entertainment, social events, or community brands.

2. **ONE image, single-page PDF, or direct link** displaying all three examples together. I want to see your work immediately without navigating multiple links or folders.

3. **Your hourly rate and total cost for 40 hours.**

4. **Confirmation that you create original logos without generative AI.**

5. **Confirmation that you can complete all deliverables by November 23.**



There's no need to send your entire portfolio or a lengthy introduction. I'd much rather see a few carefully selected examples that demonstrate your creativity and design style.



**Please follow these application instructions so I can review your work efficiently and fairly.**



### Project Timeline



**Hiring:** Immediate  

**First Interviews:** Tuesday, November 10, 2026  

**Project Duration:** 40 hours total  

**Final Deliverables Due:** Monday, November 23, 2026  

**Potential:** Additional projects and ongoing work



This is a fast-moving project, so I'm looking for someone who is available to begin immediately, communicates clearly, and can meet deadlines without compromising quality.



I'm excited to connect with a designer who can help bring this vision to life!



Looking forward to seeing your work!

title: Marketing Operations Assistant
description:
About Us & Your Role

We’re building and scaling high-velocity DTC brands.

The pace is fast. The standards are high. The upside is massive.

We’re hiring a Marketing Operations Assistant to become the executional backbone of the marketing team.

You’ll own the systems that keep everything running:

Ad scheduling

Tracking sheets

Reporting

Comment extraction

Day-to-day marketing operations

You’ll also take on new initiatives and ad hoc projects:

UGC sourcing & coordination

Influencer outreach

Competitor research

One-off high-priority projects

Anything that falls outside a clear owner — you take it and run with it.

You’ll work directly with our Head of Meta, acting as their right-hand.

The goal is simple:

Take things off their plate. Execute them fully. 

We’re looking for someone who:

Figures things out

Moves fast

Solves problems

Improves systems

If you’re organized, resourceful, and take pride in being the person who gets things done without being chased — you’ll thrive here.

If you need constant direction, prefer predictable work, or move slowly — this won’t be the right fit.

We’re building something rare.

If you want in, let’s talk.



Key Responsibilities

Own and manage the day-to-day marketing operations — ensuring core systems like ad scheduling, tracking, reporting, and comment extraction run smoothly and on time.

Build and own the UGC and influencer pipeline from scratch — sourcing creators, managing outreach, coordinating deliverables, and turning it into a repeatable, scalable system.

Execute high-priority and ad hoc projects end-to-end — taking ideas or tasks and fully running with them without needing constant direction.

Conduct ongoing competitor and market research — identifying new creative angles, trends, and insights to support the marketing team.

Support campaign execution on Meta — assisting with launches, adjustments, and resolving operational issues when needed.

Coordinate across the marketing team to ensure projects, deliverables, and campaigns move forward without delays or breakdowns.

Identify inefficiencies and improve workflows — finding ways to make processes faster, cleaner, and more reliable, including leveraging AI or automation where applicable.



Requirements

3+ years of experience in an operations, marketing, or execution-focused role (e-commerce or DTC experience is a strong plus).

Highly resourceful and able to figure things out independently without step-by-step instructions.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, systems, and priorities at once.

High attention to detail — able to catch small errors and maintain accuracy across tasks, data, and deliverables.

Fast executor — able to move quickly, handle high workload, and complete tasks without unnecessary delays.

Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to accelerate workflows, research, and problem-solving.

Clear and responsive communicator — able to work effectively with different team members and keep things moving.



Why Us

High-Growth Environment: We’re scaling fast, and as we grow, so will your role. There’s real opportunity to take on more responsibility and evolve beyond a typical “assistant” position.

Massive Learning: You’ll work across multiple areas of marketing — operations, UGC, campaigns, systems, and more — gaining hands-on experience that most roles don’t offer.

Performance Incentives: Your impact won’t go unnoticed. High performers are rewarded based on output and contribution.

Real Impact: Your work directly affects how fast and how efficiently we scale. You won’t be doing busy work — what you do matters immediately.

High-Performance Culture: You’ll work alongside a team that moves fast, takes ownership, and holds a high standard across everything.

title: Copywriter for Fitness Coach Sales Pages and Emails | Long-Term
description:
Hi, I'm Josh. I'm hiring a copywriter, long term, to write sales pages, opt-ins and

THE JOB

Write pages that convert. Know who the reader is, what she feels, and where she is in the funnel when she lands on the page. Then write it so she actually reads it and thinks "this is for me":

- it hits her pain, in her own words

- it shows the dream result she wants

- it makes her trust the coach and see why the offer is worth it

- it answers the doubts that stop her

- it makes the next step feel easy and worth doing now

So she clicks, signs up or buys.



WHAT YOU GET FROM ME

- The research: who the reader is, her worries and wants in her own words, and what she saw before your page (the reels, DMs,
s)

- The coach's own preferences: how they like to talk about their program, what they offer, what they'd never say

- The coach's voice guide, so the page sounds like them. I give you the big picture and the voice, you write the words

- A designer we pair you with. We supply them, and you two work together on every page (how, below). The design guide goes to them, so you only get what you need for the words

- You never talk to the coach. I handle every call and chat, so you just write



HOW WE MAKE A PAGE TOGETHER

1. You do the thinking first. Walk the whole funnel: what she saw before this page and what comes after it (like the checkout). Work out her objections. Then lay out every section as a header plus bullets: the objection it handles, the hidden things behind it, the point of the section, and how it leads into the next one. You hand that to the designer

2. Then formats and words happen together. The designer suggests a format for each section, you put the words in, back and forth. The format doesn't have to be right the first time. If you want a different one or small changes, tell the designer and they make them

3. You both say it's good before I see it



THE KIND OF THINKING I'M LOOKING FOR

Before you write a word, ask: where is she in the funnel? What has she already seen? Which worries are already answered, and which are still in her head right now? Someone who just found the coach and someone who just finished a free 3 day challenge need very different pages. Then write to that one person, in her words. Not corporate, not hype. A page she reads and thinks "finally, someone gets it."



HOW WORKING WITH ME GOES

- I send you a task in parts. You tell me how long each part takes you, and that's what I pay you for

s that sell something (coaching, courses, health or fitness is a plus)

NOT A FIT IF

s you wrote, closest to coaches if you have them. At least one has to be a live link to a page with your copy on it. Google Docs are fine for the rest

title: UK Real Estate Tenant Lead Generator – International Renters, Social Media & Chat Apps

I’m looking for an experienced lead generator to own the tenant pipeline, from first contact through to a booked viewing and the follow-up that turns it into a signed let. You’ll find people in places other agents don’t look, qualify them properly, and get them to viewings that turn into tenancies. I make the final decisions on eligibility and tenancy. This role suits someone who works independently and takes pride in results, not just activity.

Use a separate tracked link or code for each channel, so we know where each viewing and let came from

Reply to enquiries within 15 minutes during your hours, and qualify them (budget, move-in date, tenancy length, work or study status, number of occupants)

A property pack: photos, prices, availability and viewing rules

UK accounts that I create and own, with limited access for you

A short onboarding in week one, so you’re not guessing

 groups, Reddit, WhatsApp,

s and messages to businesses and organisations

Can spot scam enquiries, such as odd payment requests, forged documents or pressure to skip a viewing

Are willing to use time tracking during paid hours

Can be reachable about 4 hours a day between 9 AM and 6 PM UK time (4/5 PM-1/2 AM Philippine time)

Think in terms of results (lets), not just activity (messages sent)

Enjoy testing what works and dropping what doesn’t



Bonus Points



Fluent Mandarin, Cantonese, Korean or Japanese, and experience reaching audiences in those languages

Experience marketing to international students or relocating professionals

Familiarity with UK rental or student housing, and knowledge of London areas, transport and universities

Experience using AI coding tools (such as Claude Code) to build small tools, scripts or automations, such as a lead tracker dashboard, a weekly report generator or a listing caption builder. Please show me something you’ve built.

Canva or basic graphic design, and short-video scripting and editing (CapCut or similar)

Social media scheduling (Meta Business Suite, Buffer or similar) and reading analytics from Meta, TikTok or Google

Automation or CRM tools (n8n, Zapier, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, ManyChat), used within platform rules and data protection law

Calendar and booking tools (Calendly or similar)

Experience writing SOPs and checklists

Experience running or moderating an online community or group

WhatsApp Business skills (quick replies, labels, broadcast lists used within the rules)

Google Business Profile or review management

Experience writing property listings that get clicks



What I Offer (USD)



Base pay of $275-$400 per month for 15-20 hours per week, depending on experience

$200 per room let and $250 per apartment let, uncapped. This includes lets that come from partners or referrals you bring in.

$150 bonus each month with 3 or more lets

Example: 2 rooms + 1 apartment + the bonus = $800 on top of your base

Payment via Wise or PayPal, with commission paid within 7 days of the tenancy starting

Paid 4-week trial with a target of 2 lets, then ongoing if it’s working

A review at the end of the trial, with your numbers: reply time, viewings booked, show-up rate and lets

A steady supply of properties and a direct line to the decision maker



Ground Rules

No spam or mass messaging. Follow platform rules and UK data protection law. Never paste tenants’ personal details into public AI tools or share them outside the agreed systems. Any tool or script you build must be explained to me and approved before it touches my accounts, sheets or tenant data, and I never share my logins with it. Never ask prospects for money, holding fees or ID documents. I handle right to rent checks, referencing and contracts. Tell me in advance about time off, and leave a handover note in the tracker if you’ll be offline. Every applicant is treated equally, regardless of nationality or background. You qualify and book, and I make all decisions on eligibility and tenancy.



How to Apply (applications missing any of these won’t be read)

title: Video Editor
description:
FULL-TIME AD EDITOR (USA MARKET) — FEWER ADS, MORE THINKING. FOR THE EDITOR NOBODY HAS NOTICED YET.



Read this entire post before applying. If you skim it, you will fail the application in the first five seconds and we will both have wasted our time. That is not a threat — it's a favor. This job is not for most editors, and I'd rather you find that out now.





WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

You're good. Probably better than your portfolio shows. You've been stuck cutting volume for clients who never ask why an ad worked, and you notice things nobody pays you to notice: the first frame that's a beat too slow, the caption that says almost the right thing, the product shot that hides the one detail people care about.



Nobody has given you a seat where that matters. This is that seat.





WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

We are a Swedish e-commerce company. One of our brands sells a funny, giftable product, and we are building it in the United States. Our ads already work in Sweden. Now we want ads made FOR Americans, not translated for them.



Your job: 1 to 3 new ad concepts per day for the US market, each with 3 hook versions. Some days fewer, if the concept deserves it. Never more just to hit a number.



A normal day:

- You get a brief built on real American customers: their own words from our comments and reviews, and the moments Americans give gifts — Secret Santa, white elephant, stocking stuffers, birthdays, the coworker who has everything.

- You build the concept from our footage, product shots and AI tools. You make 3 versions where only the first seconds change.

- You check the small things before anyone else has to: does the first frame stop the scroll, is every caption true and readable, is the text inside the safe area, does the sound fit, would an American say it this way.

- When one of your ads wins, you help figure out WHY — and the next version is built on that answer.

- When you see a better idea in the comments, you tell us. With the comment.



Hooks, captions, pacing, sound, story. Every detail, every day.





WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT, IN THIS EXACT ORDER

1. You show up. Monday to Saturday, every scheduled day. Not "most days."

2. You care about why. You can explain every cut you made.

3. You catch your own mistakes. Nothing reaches us that you haven't watched twice, with sound and without.

4. You stay. We are building a team, not renting a freelancer for two months.

5. Your editing skill — and how fast it grows.



Notice that skill is fifth. That is not a mistake. Skill we can grow: we have a whole system for briefs, hooks and learnings. And the person who reads this carefully and types "wasabi" as the first word of the subject line is already showing me the exact trait I'm hiring for. It is not mentioned in the subject line structure below, but it is supposed to be the first word, then the structure. What we cannot teach is a person who cares about the details when nobody is watching.





HOURS — NORMAL ONES

Monday to Saturday, 8 hours per day, Philippine time. Roughly 09:00–18:00 PHT with a break. We lock your exact hours together before you start.

No graveyard shift. No night work. You sleep at night like a normal human being.

Occasional Sunday pushes before a big launch. Paid extra, never assumed.

You keep your Philippine holidays. Tell us in advance.



If you cannot commit to six days a week, every week, do not apply.





PAY — READ THIS PART SLOWLY

A real monthly salary, not piece work. You are paid for great concepts, not for counting files.



Monthly salary: $520 USD. Paid twice a month, on time, every time. We have never missed a payment and we never will.



On top of that:

0.4% commission on the ad spend of every ad you made. Every month, uncapped. When your ad scales, you scale with it. This is the real upside: one ad that takes off can pay you more than your salary.

$60 USD consistency bonus every month with zero missed days.



The raise ladder, in writing:

Start: $520

After 1 month: $550

After 3 months: $580

After 6 months: $620



Every step is automatic as long as you deliver. It goes into your agreement on day one. You will never have to ask for a raise. The first one comes after ONE month, not six. Commission sits on top of every step.



Notice how the pay is built. The salary keeps you safe. The commission rewards exactly one thing: ads that work. That is why we don't need you to make 10 a day. We need you to make the one that wins.



What counts as done: follows the brief, correct format, captions clean and true, no technical errors, delivered on time. If I send something back, I tell you exactly why in one sentence, and it counts once you fix it.





WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

- You want to push out as many clips as possible and not think about them.

- You are juggling other clients and this would be "one of them."

- You get defensive when a version doesn't work. Most versions don't. That's how we find the one that does.

- Your internet is unreliable and you have no backup connection.

- You have no plan for brownouts or power cuts.

- You cannot work six days a week.

- You are not comfortable recording a short video of yourself with your camera on.

- You want to negotiate the salary before you've proven a single month.





HOW TO APPLY — THIS IS THE FIRST TEST

Ninety percent of applicants will get this wrong. That's the point.



1. Subject line, formatted EXACTLY like this:

| [your main editing software] | [years editing short-form ads] | [hours/day you can work] | [days/week you can work] | [your download speed from speedtest.net]



Example: XXXXXX | CapCut | 2 | 8 | 6 | 45mbps



Wrong format, missing codeword or a missing field — deleted unread.



2. Your message contains ONE thing: a link to a Loom video. No cover letter, no CV.



It must be Loom (
). The free plan is enough. Set it so anyone with the link can watch. Maximum 5 minutes. In English. Camera on, your face visible.



In the video, cover these six things, in this order:

1. Who you are, and the ad you're most proud of. Play it on screen.

2. Walk me through that ad: why that first frame, why that hook, why that order. If it performed, tell me what you think made it work. If you don't know whether it performed, say so.

3. One thing in that ad you would change today, and why.

4. Your setup. Computer, internet, backup internet, what you do when the power goes out. Run speedtest.net on screen. The number must match your subject line.

5. Longevity, and your breaking point. The longest you have stayed with one client and why it ended. Then: what would make you quit this job? I trust the person who names it far more than the person who says "nothing."

6. The last thing you say: a brief tells you to open on the product, but ten customer comments say the funny part is the moment someone opens the gift. What do you do?



Never show a client's private files, names or accounts on your screen.



3. If I message you, reply within 24 hours. Answering fast is part of the job, so it is part of the test.





THE THREE STAGES

Stage 1 — The Loom above. Most people won't do it.



Stage 2 — The concept test. Unpaid. I send you footage, a brief and real customer comments. You deliver ONE concept with 3 hook versions within 48 hours, plus a short Loom (max 3 minutes) explaining your choices. One detail in the brief is wrong on purpose. I'm watching whether you notice it.



Stage 3 — Paid trial week. Real briefs, real ads in our account, real feedback. This is where the seat is won.





WHAT YOU GET IF YOU WIN IT

One company, one market to own, the same people every day. Daytime hours. A salary on time, twice a month, and a raise on a schedule. Your ads running in the United States with real money behind them — you see exactly how they perform, and you earn on every one that scales.



And a real path. The editors who learn why ads win become creative strategists. We train you for it. That comes after months of great work, not instead of it.



If you're tired of being the editor nobody asks for an opinion — and you have one — this is that.



Show me you care about the details. That's the whole first test.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



DeepSky is committed to empowering entrepreneurs in the U.S. with financial clarity and actionable insights. We believe accurate and timely financial information is essential for business owners to make informed decisions and grow their companies.



We are looking for a results-driven Accounting Manager who takes ownership of accounting operations, leads a team of accounting professionals, and ensures the accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of financial records.



At DeepSky, we value individuals who focus on delivering tangible outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks. We encourage independent thinking, accountability, and continuous improvement.



Our clients are U.S.-based businesses with annual revenues ranging from $1 million to $20 million. We provide outsourced accounting services, including day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable, accounts receivable, month-end closing, and financial reporting.



As an Accounting Manager, your primary responsibility will be overseeing our accounting team and ensuring that financial data is accurate, complete, and delivered on time.



While occasional client communication will be required, this position is primarily focused on internal accounting operations, quality control, and team management. Senior leadership will continue to manage the majority of client relationships, financial advisory discussions, and strategic communications.



We are looking for someone who can independently manage daily accounting operations, identify problems before they escalate, and ensure the team consistently delivers high-quality work.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



+ Team Management & Accountability



Supervise and manage accounting associates responsible for multiple U.S.-based client accounts.



Assign tasks, establish priorities, and ensure deadlines are consistently met.



Monitor team workloads, productivity, and work quality.



Review completed work and provide constructive feedback to improve accuracy and efficiency.



Train, mentor, and develop team members to strengthen their accounting knowledge and capabilities.



Identify performance issues and implement corrective actions when necessary.



Establish clear accountability and ensure team members take ownership of their responsibilities.



+ Accounting Accuracy & Quality Control



Oversee the accuracy and completeness of financial records across multiple client accounts.



Review bank and credit card reconciliations, journal entries, and transaction classifications.



Identify and resolve accounting discrepancies, unusual balances, and incomplete transactions.



Ensure proper recording of accruals, prepayments, and other accounting adjustments.



Review balance sheet accounts and supporting schedules to ensure financial information is reliable.



Maintain consistent accounting standards and internal controls across client accounts.



Escalate significant accounting issues to senior leadership with proposed solutions.



+ Month-End Closing & Financial Reporting



Oversee month-end closing processes for assigned clients.



Ensure all reconciliations, adjustments, and supporting schedules are completed accurately and on time.



Review financial statements for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.



Investigate unusual account balances and financial fluctuations.



Coordinate with accounting staff to resolve outstanding items before reporting deadlines.



Ensure financial records are properly organized and ready for senior management review.



+ Accounting Operations & Workflow Management



Oversee daily accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bookkeeping activities.



Monitor outstanding accounting tasks and ensure timely completion.



Maintain and improve accounting workflows, checklists, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).



Identify inefficiencies and implement practical solutions to improve team productivity.



Utilize cloud-based accounting software and automation tools to streamline operations.



Ensure proper documentation and consistency across client accounts.



+ Internal Communication & Coordination



Provide regular updates to senior leadership regarding team performance, closing progress, and outstanding accounting issues.



Proactively identify potential delays, discrepancies, or operational challenges.



Communicate directly with clients when necessary to clarify transactions, obtain missing information, or resolve routine accounting matters.



Coordinate with senior leadership on complex accounting issues and client-related concerns.



Ensure accounting deliverables are completed with minimal need for daily supervision.



ABOUT YOU



You are an experienced accounting professional who enjoys building organized, efficient, and accountable teams.



You understand that managing an accounting team requires more than assigning tasks. It means reviewing work, identifying mistakes, solving problems, and ensuring that every team member delivers accurate results on time.



You are highly detail-oriented, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of accounting operations without constant direction.



You are confident in your accounting knowledge and capable of identifying errors, investigating discrepancies, and guiding your team toward solutions.



Most importantly, you are proactive. You don't wait for someone else to discover a problem or remind you about a deadline. You take responsibility for ensuring the work gets done correctly.



QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS



Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.



Minimum 5 years of professional accounting experience.



At least 2 years of experience supervising or managing accounting staff.



Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and accrual accounting principles.



Proven experience managing month-end closing processes.



Strong knowledge of financial statements, reconciliations, and general ledger accounting.



Experience with cloud-based accounting software such as Xero or QuickBooks Online.



Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.



Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.



Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Ability to manage multiple client accounts and competing deadlines.



Demonstrated ability to work independently and take ownership of results.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with U.S.-based accounting firms or outsourced accounting teams.



Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously.



Familiarity with 
 and other accounting automation platforms.



CPA certification or equivalent accounting qualification.



Experience developing SOPs, improving accounting workflows, or implementing quality-control procedures.



Technology Adaptability & AI Proficiency: Comfortable adopting new technologies and leveraging AI-powered tools to improve accounting accuracy, streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance team productivity.



Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Demonstrates curiosity and initiative in exploring emerging technologies and identifying practical opportunities to integrate AI and automation into daily accounting operations.



WORK SCHEDULE & EXPECTATIONS



This position requires working U.S. business hours to support our U.S.-based clients and internal team.



Candidates must be available for daily team coordination, internal meetings, accounting reviews, and reporting deadlines during designated U.S. business hours.



While DeepSky values flexibility and independent time management, consistent availability, accountability, and responsiveness during working hours are mandatory.



INITIAL 3-MONTH TRIAL PERIOD



During the initial three-month trial period, candidates will undergo onboarding, training, and performance evaluations.



The evaluation will focus primarily on accounting accuracy, team management, operational efficiency, and the ability to independently oversee accounting workflows.



Successful candidates will continue in a full-time position with comprehensive company benefits.



SUCCESS METRICS DURING THE TRIAL PERIOD



Accounting Accuracy & Quality Control



Demonstrate the ability to identify and resolve accounting errors independently.



Maintain at least 95% accuracy in reviewed accounting work.



Ensure material discrepancies are investigated and resolved or appropriately escalated.



Month-End Closing



Ensure assigned client accounts are closed accurately within established deadlines.



Maintain complete reconciliations and supporting documentation.



Reduce outstanding accounting issues and unnecessary delays.



Team Management



Effectively manage assigned accounting staff and ensure timely completion of responsibilities.



Demonstrate the ability to delegate, review, and provide feedback independently.



Maintain accountability and clear communication across the team.



Operational Efficiency



Identify at least one significant opportunity to improve accounting workflows.



Implement process improvements that reduce errors, delays, or unnecessary manual work.



Demonstrate the ability to oversee daily operations with minimal senior management involvement.



ADDITIONAL APPLICATION REQUIREMENT



Please include your resume and answer the following questions when applying:



How many accounting staff members have you managed, and how did you ensure their work was completed accurately and on time?



Describe a time when you discovered a significant accounting error made by your team. How did you resolve the issue and prevent it from happening again?



If you were managing five accountants handling multiple clients and several month-end deadlines were approaching, how would you prioritize and organize the team's work?



What is your favorite book or movie, and why?



Candidates who do not answer all four questions will automatically be excluded from consideration.



We look forward to meeting individuals who are ready to take ownership, lead with confidence, and help DeepSky deliver exceptional accounting services.

title: Full Cycle Sales Rep (Cold Calling + Closing) | US Auto Shops | Base + Commission
description:
