Shops use it to take online bookings and deposits, let customers pay over time with Klarna, Afterpay and Affirm, and automatically follow up on quotes that never booked.



We are hiring ONE full cycle sales rep. You find the shops, call them, book the demo, run the demo and close the deal. If you love the phone and want to be paid for results, keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Build your own call lists from public sources (we train you on exactly how)

• Make 80 to 100 cold calls a day to shop owners

• Book and run short 20 minute screen share demos

• Close deals and send the checkout link on the call

• Log every call and note in our CRM



SCHEDULE

• Full time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday

• 10am to 6pm US Eastern time (10pm to 6am Manila time)



PAY (all paid weekly in USD via Wise or PayPal)

• Base: $520 a month ($120 a week). Rises to $650 a month ($150 a week) once you hit the week 2 target

• Monthly client: 50% of the first month ($248.50 per close), then 10% of every monthly payment ($49.70 a month per client) for 12 months

• Annual client: 20% of the annual plan, $994, paid in that week's payout

• Commission is returned if a client refunds or disputes within 60 days



WHAT THIS CAN LOOK LIKE

• Close 3 shops a month and earn about $1,600 a month by month 3, with recurring pay that grows every month you stay

• Close one annual plan and get $994 that week



TARGETS

• 80 to 100 dials a day

• 3 demos held by the end of week 2

• First close by the end of week 4

Weeks 1 and 2 are a paid trial.



YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

• Have 1+ year of B2B cold calling or closing experience with US businesses

• Speak clear, confident English

• Handle rejection and objections calmly

• Have a quiet workspace, a headset and reliable internet

• Can work US Eastern hours consistently



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed)

1. Put the word CERAMIC in your application subject line.

2. Include a link to a 60 second voice recording (Vocaroo or Google Drive) of you reading this opener out loud, as if calling a shop owner:

"Hi, is this the owner? I know you're probably in the middle of a job, so I'll be quick. We work with paint protection and ceramic shops, and most shops we talk to lose a lot of quotes because nobody follows up. Can I take 30 seconds to tell you how we fix that?"

3. Answer these three questions:

   a. What is the best result you have had in a cold calling role? Give numbers (dials, demos, closes).

   b. A shop owner says "just send me some info." What exactly do you say next?

   c. Have you closed deals yourself, or only booked appointments? Share your best month.

This is a phone role, 4 hours a day, fully remote. You'll be the first real voice a seller hears from us, so how you sound on the phone matters more than anything else.

What you'll do

• Call warm leads fast: when a landowner says yes to selling over text, you get them on the phone right away while they're still interested, then keep working down a ranked daily call list

• Follow a proven call script: confirm the property, ask about access, ownership and timeline, and find out why they might sell

• Qualify every seller properly: get their asking price, their timeline and their reason for selling on every call, so we know which leads are real

• Book an offer call on our calendar before you hang up

• Follow a set callback schedule for sellers who don't answer: voi
, a text and a call again on set days

• Log every call in our CRM (Stride) and on our call board, and post a short call summary in Slack

You won't make offers or talk numbers. Our team handles every price conversation. Your job is to learn about the land and the seller and get the offer call booked.

Schedule and pay





Hours

9:00 am to 1:00 pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday (20 hours a week)

Base pay

$5 per hour

Deal bonus

$300 for every property we buy from a seller you spoke with on the first call (paid once the land is in our name, for deals that go under contract within 90 days of your call)

Pay schedule

Weekly, every Friday

Type

Independent contractor, fully remote

This role can grow. As you prove yourself on the phone, more hours and more responsibility are possible over time, including taking on more of the deal process.

What we're looking for

Required

• Excellent spoken English with a clear accent that US landowners, many of them older and rural, understand easily on the phone

• At least 1 year of outbound calling experience (real estate, sales, appointment setting or similar)

• Quick to act: you call warm leads the moment they come in, without needing to be pushed, and qualify them with direct questions about price, timeline and reasons for selling in a friendly way

• Able to listen, let people talk, and politely steer back to the questions

• A quiet place to work, a good headset and reliable internet

• Available 9:00 am to 1:00 pm US Eastern every weekday

Nice to have

• Experience with real estate or land sellers

• Experience with GoHighLevel, Slack or a similar CRM

• Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude

• You've worked with US clients before

How to apply

We only review applications that include a voice recording. Start your application with the words "gravel road" so we know you read this far.

With your application, send:

1. Your resume or a short summary of your calling experience

2. A link to one voice recording, 1 to 2 minutes long, that includes both parts below. Record it on Vocaroo or upload it to Google Drive, and make sure anyone with the link can listen.

Part 1: read this out loud the way you'd say it on a real call

"Hey Mark, it's [your name] with Ridgeline Land. Did I catch you at a bad time? Awesome, this won't take long. We were texting with you about a piece of land you own, and you mentioned you might be open to selling it. I just wanted to follow up and make sure we understood that right."

"Most people who've owned land for a while have at least a rough number in mind. What would you want to walk away with for it to make sense to sell?"

Part 2: answer these in your own words

1. Tell us about your outbound calling experience. What were you calling about, and for how long?

2. A seller asks you, "So what would you pay me for it?" What do you say?

3. Can you work 9:00 am to 1:00 pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday?

We'll invite the strongest applicants to a short live role-play call.
salary: 5$ an Hour plus 300 bonus on closed deal

title: In-House SEO Strategist — Local + AI Search for a US Cleaning Brand
description:
Read every word. There's a challenge near the bottom that d
 whether we ever talk. Skim it and you're already out — an SEO who doesn't read carefully isn't an SEO we want.



We're Greater Phoenix Cleaning. We clean homes and businesses across Phoenix, Arizona, and we're building this into a multi-seven-figure company with locations opening across the United States. We already know how to sell and how to clean. Now we're going all-in on owning search — traditional AND AI — and we want one person to own it completely.



This is not a "post a few blogs and tweak title tags" job. This is the keys to our entire organic growth engine.



THE MISSION

Take Greater Phoenix Cleaning to 300+ inbound organic leads per month. Dominate the Google Map Pack in every ZIP code we serve, go deeper neighborhood by neighborhood for our ideal customer, and make us the business that shows up whether someone types it into Google, says it into Maps, or asks an AI assistant "who's the best cleaner near me." Then hand us the repeatable playbook to do it again in every city we open. You'll be honest that this is a 12–18 month compounding build, not a magic switch — and then you'll go build it.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The best of the best. An SEO nerd in the best possible way — someone who lives, eats, sleeps, and breathes search. The profile:

- 10+ years in SEO, and it's the ONLY thing you do. Not "SEO + web design + ads." Pure SEO obsession.

- Deep expertise across Local SEO, GEO / location-based SEO, AI Search Optimization (AEO/GEO), and Google Business Profile optimization.

- You've ranked local service businesses to the top of the map pack and page one, with proven, measurable growth in rankings, organic traffic, leads, and engagement. Cleaning companies = ideal. Home-service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, pest, landscaping, roofing) = strong. Everyone else with real proof = welcome.

- You're on the bleeding edge of AI search RIGHT NOW — Google AI Overviews, answer engines, LLM/generative search — and you already optimize for AI-generated results, not just the ten blue links.

- You go to SEO masterminds. You have (or had) an SEO mentor. You sharpen constantly — because whoever stopped learning in 2022 is already obsolete.

- Happy, hungry, humble, sharp. Good energy. Coachable ego. Zero laziness — anywhere.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Full SEO audits of our website, technical health, and entire local presence.

- Keyword and competitor research — local, long-tail, and neighborhood-level.

- On-page and technical SEO: site structure, content optimization, schema markup, page speed, internal linking.

- Local ranking signals: Google Business Profile optimization, business listings and citation management, NAP consistency, and review velocity strategy.

- GEO / location-based SEO: unique, genuinely valuable service-area and neighborhood landing pages across every ZIP we serve.

- AI Search Optimization / Answer Engine Optimization: optimize our content and entities so we surface in AI Overviews, generative results, and AI assistant answers.

- A relentless content engine — blogs and pages that are actually valuable, never thin junk.

- Real reporting. We keep score here: leads, rankings, traffic, engagement — not vanity metrics.

- The repeatable system we roll out to every new city.



WHY THIS BEATS AGENCY LIFE

We're anti-corporate. No clients to juggle, no account managers watering down your work, no politics. ONE brand, your full focus, real budget, and a team that actually ships what you recommend — fast. You'll work directly with the owner. Perform, and you help architect the SEO engine for a national franchise. We build leaders here, and we pay for results.



THE PAY

Base of $1,500/month, plus a performance bonus tied directly to the results you create:

- +$250/month once we sustain 100+ organic leads/month

- +$500/month once we sustain 200+ organic leads/month

- +$1,000/month once we sustain 300+ organic leads/month (the mission)

That's up to $2,500+/month total for hitting the target you were hired to hit — and for someone who proves they're truly elite, we'll go higher. We pay for results here, not for logging hours.



THE HONEST PART

We're demanding and we move fast. We'll give you resources and get out of your way — and in return we expect ownership, honesty about timelines, and relentless execution. If you want to coast, we're not it. If you want one brand you can take to the absolute top and point to for the rest of your career — welcome home.



HOW TO APPLY (this is the real test — most SEOs will fail it, and that's the point)



We're hiring an expert, so prove you're one. Generic copy-paste proposals get deleted unread. Do all of this:



1. Start your message with the word PAGEONE in all caps. No PAGEONE, no reply — we'll know you skimmed. (First test: passed or failed.)



2. Go look at our website (
) and our Google Business Profile. In 5–8 sentences, tell us the single biggest thing you'd fix in your first 30 days to move our map pack rankings — and WHY. Be specific. This is what separates the real ones from the fakers.



3. Show us proof. Send at least one business you personally ranked — the URL, the keyword(s), and the before/after (screenshots, Ahrefs/SEMrush data, or a case study link). Cleaning or home-service examples move to the top of our pile.



4. Tell us your exact SEO stack (the tools you use) and one specific way you're optimizing for AI search / answer engines in 2026 that most people aren't.



5. Tell us the last SEO mastermind, course, mentor, or community you were part of — and one thing it changed about how you work.



Do all five and you're ahead of 95% of applicants. We read every application that starts with PAGEONE.



Let's take this brand to the top.



— The Greater Phoenix Cleaning Team

title: Exciting Sales Closer + Ops Role for Busy Residential & Commercial Cleaning Company (US Based)
description:
Read every word. There's an instruction near the bottom that gets you hired. Miss it and you're out — that's test #1, and it starts now.



We're Greater Phoenix Cleaning. We clean homes and businesses across Phoenix, Arizona, and we are on a tear — building this into a multi-seven-figure company with locations opening across the United States.



Think of us like a championship sports team. Everyone here is a starter. Everyone is accountable. We train hard, we keep score, we celebrate the wins loudly, and we don't carry passengers. If you're used to hiding in the middle of a big org where nobody notices you coasting — you will hate it here, and we'll notice fast.



We're hiring ONE leader. A Closer. Someone who can run the day-to-day of a busy cleaning company, close deals on the phone, take an angry customer and turn them into a raving fan, keep a crew of cleaners moving, and stay calm and sharp when the day goes sideways — because some days, it will.



We hire leaders, not order-takers. If you need someone telling you what to do every hour, close this post — we'll both be happier. If you see a problem and just handle it, keep reading.



THE ONE THING THAT'S NON-NEGOTIABLE

We do not hire lazy. Not "a little lazy on Fridays." Not "lazy in the parts nobody sees." If you cut corners anywhere in your life, it shows up everywhere eventually — and it has no home on this team. We want the person who does it right when no one is watching, who finishes what they start, and who is a little annoyed by their own unfinished work. If that's not you, you already know, and this will save us both time.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Close deals. Talk to people who want their space cleaned and turn them into paying customers. Negotiate, handle objections, win. Recurring customers and raving fans are the engine of this company. One-time cleans are not. Turning the customer into a fan and a long-term friend is the goal!



Own escalations. When a customer is upset, you step in, take the heat, fix it, and save the relationship. People feel handled when they deal with you.



Run the day. Keep jobs on track, connect customers and cleaners, put out the small fires before they become big ones.

Lead the crew. Not babysit — lead. Set the standard, hold the line, help people win.



Upgrade the machine. Spot what's slow or broken and build a better way. Solve a problem once so it never comes back.



WHO YOU ARE



Happy. Real energy. People feel better after talking to you. This matters more than you'd guess.

Hungry. You want to grow, earn, and build something real. Coasting bores you.

Humble. You take hard feedback like a pro and never think you're above the work.

Sharp. Fast learner. You connect dots other people walk right past.

A leader. You've led something — a team, a shift, a project — and you were good at it. People follow you without being told to.

A self-development junkie. Books, courses, podcasts — nobody has to push you. You sharpen your craft on your own time because you actually enjoy it.

Growth mindset. "I don't know how yet." Every setback is just data.



WHY THIS BEATS A CORPORATE JOB

No red tape. No politics. No pretending to look busy. We move fast, we have fun, we treat people like adults, and we keep score honestly. You'll work directly with the owner and have a real seat at the table as we scale nationwide. The people who join early and perform are the people who lead our future locations. We build leaders here — that's the entire point.



THE HONEST PART

This is demanding. Customers can be hard, days get chaotic, and you'll be trusted with a lot, fast. If you want easy and quiet, we are not it. If you want to be pushed, to grow, to earn, and to help build something that becomes a household name across America — welcome home.



Cleaning, home-services, dispatch, or field-team experience is a real plus. But we'll take a phenomenal leader and teach them cleaning over someone who knows cleaning but can't lead. Both? Even better.



HOW TO APPLY (this is the tryout — you're going to close us on camera)

We're a sales team. So don't type us an essay — we won't read a wall of text, and neither will your future customers. Get on camera and close us. If you can't close us on hiring you, you can't close the people who pay us. It's that simple.



Two things — that's the whole application:



-Put the word DESERT in the first line of your message so we know you read this. No DESERT, no reply. (Test #1 — passed or failed before we even hit play.)



-Record a 2–3 minute video of YOURSELF ON CAMERA — face visible. Not a voice-only clip. Not just your screen. You, talking to the lens like it's a customer who just said "let me think about it." Loom, YouTube unlisted, Google Drive — paste the link. In it, close us:

1. Who you are and why you're a leader, not an order-taker. Ten seconds. Don't ramble — tight is a skill.

2. One time you turned an angry customer or a bad situation completely around. Specifics. What you did, how it ended.

3. What you're doing right now to get better at your craft — the last book, course, or podcast you finished and the one thing you actually changed.

4. Then close. Ask us for the job. Handle the objection out loud: "Why you over everyone else applying?" Sell us. Don't be shy — that's the entire test.



No cover letter. No essay. If the video isn't there — or it's a black screen with a voice — we skip it, no exceptions. The people who won't get on camera are exactly the people we don't want on the phone.



We watch every video that comes in with DESERT. Show us the close.



Let's go build something big.



— The Greater Phoenix Cleaning Team

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist
description:
About the Role



I’m looking for a highly experienced Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist to join my content creation business on a full-time, long-term basis.



I am a medical doctor and content creator producing educational, skincare, beauty and lifestyle content across TikTok and Instagram.



This is not a junior editing role. I am looking for someone with significant professional short-form editing experience, exceptional creative judgement and a strong understanding of what drives performance across TikTok, Instagram and the wider social media landscape.



The role combines senior-level short-form video editing, creative direction, content ideation and social media trend awareness.



A core part of this position will be proactively helping to develop and evolve the editing style of the content. The successful candidate should not simply replicate the existing editing style. They should continuously assess how short-form content is changing and use those insights to introduce new editing techniques, formats and creative approaches that make the content more dynamic, current and engaging.



The role also includes proactive content ideation. I am looking for someone who is genuinely immersed in social media and naturally identifies emerging audios, trends, formats, memes, conversations and cultural moments that could be developed into relevant content ideas.



This is a permanent, full-time position within a fast-paced content business where daily posting is a core priority. Reliability, flexibility, creative initiative, responsiveness and consistently meeting deadlines are essential.



Core Responsibilities



Senior Short-Form Editing & Creative Direction



* Edit high-performing short-form content for TikTok and Instagram, across both organic content and paid brand partnerships

* Optimise content for viewer retention, watch time, engagement and overall platform performance

* Use strong creative judgement to strengthen hooks, pacing, structure, storytelling and overall execution

* Proactively identify opportunities within content to improve performance rather than relying on detailed instructions for every creative decision

* Understand the differences between what performs on TikTok and Instagram and adapt editing styles, pacing, formats and creative choices accordingly

* Identify opportunities to strengthen content through relevant visual assets, memes, cultural references, trends, audio and platform-native creative techniques

* Maintain an exceptionally high standard of quality, accuracy and attention to detail

* Take ownership of edits from raw footage through to final approval



Evolving the Editing Style



A major responsibility of this role is to actively help shape and evolve the creative editing direction of the content.



The successful candidate will be expected to:



* Continuously assess how high-performing short-form content is evolving across TikTok and Instagram

* Proactively introduce new editing styles, techniques and creative approaches that can make the content more dynamic and engaging

* Identify elements of the existing editing style that could be refreshed, improved or replaced

* Suggest and experiment with new approaches to hooks, pacing, visual storytelling, text treatments, graphics, audio and overall content structure

* Recognise emerging editing trends early and assess whether they are genuinely relevant to the creator’s content and audience

* Help ensure the content remains current, competitive and platform-native, rather than relying on an editing formula that becomes dated over time

* Balance creative evolution with consistency so that the content continues to feel recognisably aligned with the creator’s personal brand



The expectation is not simply to follow an established editing template. The editor should bring the experience and creative judgement required to help determine what the editing style should become next.



Content Ideation & Trend Spotting



This role extends beyond editing and includes an important content ideation component.



The successful candidate will be expected to:



* Proactively bring forward content ideas rather than waiting solely for content to be assigned

* Regularly identify trending audios, formats, memes, conversations, cultural moments and emerging social media trends that could be relevant to the creator’s content

* Suggest specific ways those trends could be adapted into original TikTok or Instagram content

* Identify emerging or high-performing content formats and suggest how they could be applied to educational, skincare, beauty, lifestyle or personality-led content

* Bring forward ideas for new hooks, video structures, recurring formats and creative concepts

* Proactively share useful creative references and examples

* Understand the difference between blindly following a trend and identifying trends that can be adapted naturally and strategically to the creator’s audience and personal brand

* Remain sufficiently immersed in TikTok, Instagram and wider social media culture to identify opportunities while they are relevant, rather than once a trend has already passed



For example, if an audio, meme or format begins trending and there is a strong way to adapt it to the creator’s content, the expectation is that the editor would identify that opportunity and proactively suggest the content idea.



Picture Carousels & Canva



* Create high-quality picture carousel content for TikTok and Instagram using Canva

* Turn supplied copy, information and concepts into polished, engaging and platform-appropriate carousel content

* Contribute creative ideas around carousel formats, layouts, hooks and visual treatments

* Maintain a strong and consistent visual identity

* Source relevant imagery, graphics, screenshots and visual references where required

* Keep up to date with evolving carousel styles and formats across TikTok and Instagram

* Help evolve carousel design alongside the broader creative direction of the social channels



Paid Brand Partnerships



* Edit paid brand partnerships to a consistently high standard while maintaining the creator’s organic content style

* Understand and accurately execute campaign briefs and brand requirements

* Balance mandatory brand messaging with the need for content to remain engaging and native to the platform

* Identify creative ways to integrate brand requirements without making the content feel unnecessarily commercial

* Handle brand revisions accurately and efficiently



Seniority & Experience



This is explicitly a senior-level position.



Applicants should have significant professional experience editing short-form social media content and be able to demonstrate a strong portfolio of high-quality work.



The successful candidate must already have the technical foundations expected of an experienced professional editor. This role is focused on a higher level of contribution: creative judgement, strategic thinking, platform knowledge, content performance, creative direction and proactive ideation.



Applicants should be able to demonstrate:



* Significant professional short-form video editing experience

* A strong portfolio of TikTok, Instagram Reels or comparable vertical content

* Experience editing content designed to achieve strong social media performance

* Advanced proficiency in CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro

* Strong proficiency in Canva

* Excellent knowledge of TikTok and Instagram

* A sophisticated understanding of viewer psychology, retention, hooks and short-form storytelling

* Strong awareness of social media culture, emerging trends and platform behaviour

* The ability to distinguish between a fleeting trend and a genuinely valuable creative opportunity

* Strong independent creative judgement

* The confidence to suggest improvements or challenge an existing creative approach where appropriate

* The ability to take ownership of an edit without requiring detailed step-by-step direction

* Strong English comprehension and excellent attention to detail

* Clear and proactive communication

* Strong organisation and time-management skills

* The ability to manage multiple priorities within a fast-moving content environment



What I’m Looking For



The ideal editor is someone who:



* Takes genuine pride in producing exceptionally high-quality work

* Is highly experienced and confident in their creative judgement

* Understands what makes content perform across both TikTok and Instagram and can adapt editing styles, pacing and formats accordingly

* Understands the psychology behind high-performing short-form content

* Knows how to strengthen hooks and improve viewer retention through editing

* Can identify moments where pacing, captions, visuals, memes, cultural references or structure can be improved to maximise performance

* Keeps up to date with TikTok and Instagram trends, formats, platform updates and changes in audience behaviour

* Understands how to incorporate relevant trends naturally into content where appropriate to maximise engagement and performance

* Proactively helps evolve the editing style rather than simply reproducing the existing one

* Is excited by the opportunity to develop new and more dynamic creative approaches as social media evolves

* Regularly brings forward content ideas, trending audios, formats and creative references without needing to be asked

* Thinks beyond the individual edit and contributes to the broader creative direction and performance of the content

* Can follow a creator’s style while also bringing strong creative ideas and suggestions

* Understands when innovation will strengthen a piece of content and when a simpler approach is more effective

* Learns from feedback and consistently applies it to future work

* Communicates clearly and proactively

* Is highly dependable and consistent

* Takes ownership of deliverables and deadlines

* Does not need to be repeatedly chased or micromanaged

* Is comfortable operating at the pace required by a creator publishing content daily



This role supports a creator who is looking to post daily content. Reliability and meeting deadlines are therefore essential.



Turnaround Expectations



This is a fast-paced full-time role, and applicants must be comfortable working to consistently short turnaround times.



First Draft Turnaround



Once raw footage has been received, a fully edited first draft must be delivered within approximately 4–6 hours, depending on the length and complexity of the video.



For particularly complex or editing-intensive videos, turnaround may extend to up to 12 hours.



The expectation is that newly received footage is prioritised and editing begins promptly. This is not a role operating on a traditional freelance editing turnaround of 24–48 hours.



Applicants should only apply if they are genuinely comfortable maintaining this level of turnaround consistently.



Revisions



* Straightforward revisions must be actioned urgently upon receipt of feedback

* More substantial revisions must also be prioritised and completed as quickly as possible

* The editor must remain highly responsive to feedback and revision requests

* Previous feedback must be retained and applied to future edits to minimise unnecessary repeat revision rounds



Flexibility & Availability



This is a full-time role with flexible working hours.



There are no fixed or pre-agreed daily working hours. Instead, the successful candidate must be flexible around the requirements of a fast-moving content schedule.



* The successful candidate must have the flexibility to adapt their working pattern around when footage, feedback and content requirements arise

* Capacity to edit content consistently throughout the week is essential

* Weekend availability is a non-negotiable requirement of the role

* Urgent edits may occasionally require a faster turnaround

* The editor must be highly responsive and able to adapt where necessary to meet content and campaign deadlines

* Any known periods of unavailability must be communicated in advance



Communication, Reliability & Ownership



The successful candidate must:



* Communicate clearly and proactively

* Be highly responsive to new content, feedback and changing priorities

* Keep the creator/team updated on the status of edits where necessary

* Flag potential issues or delays before they affect a deadline

* Take ownership of assigned work rather than requiring repeated follow-up

* Manage priorities independently

* Maintain high standards even when working to fast turnaround times

* Be dependable and consistent



Typical Deliverables



Typical workload includes:



* Approximately 7 short-form videos per week

* Picture carousel content for TikTok and Instagram as required

* A mix of organic content and paid brand partnerships

* Videos generally between 30–90 seconds

* Revisions and alternative versions where required

* Proactive content ideas, trend recommendations and creative references



Workload may fluctuate depending on the content calendar, brand campaigns and wider business requirements.



Confidentiality & Content Ownership



The editor may have access to unreleased content, brand campaign information and other confidential business material.



All footage, content, campaign materials and other confidential information must be treated accordingly and may not be shared, uploaded or repurposed externally without permission.



All final content, project files and creative assets produced as part of the role will remain the property of the business.



Role Details



Position: Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist

Employment: Full-time, permanent / long-term

Location: Remote

Hours: Full-time with flexible working hours based around content requirements and deadlines

Weekend availability: Required and non-negotiable

Start Date: As soon as possible



Application Requirements



Please include:



* A portfolio of short-form content within the following niches ONLY 



skincare, 

beauty,

Haircare

 lifestyle



* At least 7–10 examples of TikTok, Instagram Reels or comparable short-form content that you have personally edited

* Examples that demonstrate a range of editing styles, formats and creative approaches where possible

* Examples of TikTok or Instagram picture carousels you have created



Please *only* apply if you have experience editing high-performing short-form content within the above niches, are comfortable contributing proactively to content ideation and creative direction, and can consistently work to the fast turnaround times outlined above.



Applications will be immediately disqualified if you are unable to demonstrate previous video editing experience within the beauty/skincare/haircare/lifestyle niche

title: Full-Time Legal Administrative Bankruptcy Assistant (US Bankruptcy Law Firm)
description:

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Collect, review and organize client documents such as pay stubs, bank statements, tax returns and IDs

- Rename, combine and file documents in our client folders following our naming system

- Track missing documents and follow up with clients by
 and phone

- Enter client information into our bankruptcy software "Next Chapter"

- Help prepare income summaries and document checklists for attorney review

- Keep attorney calendars, court deadlines and 341 meeting dates up to date

- Manage the inbox and draft routine client correspondence

- Handle other administrative and case-related tasks as needed

- We also manage several short term rentals (Airbnb's) which you may be expected to assist with such as guest messaging, supply ordering, and maintenance coordination



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 1 year of experience as a legal assistant, paralegal or admin assistant (U.S. law firm experience preferred)

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong attention to detail. You’ll be handling financial documents where accuracy matters.

- Comfortable with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, and with PDF tools in Adobe Acrobat

- Reliable computer, high-speed internet and a backup power/internet plan

- Able to work U.S. Eastern Time hours consistently

- Willing to sign a confidentiality agreement

- Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your work.

- Claude Cowork experience preferred; training provided

- Comfortable with Gmail, Google Drive, Docs/Sheets, and Microsoft Suite.

- Reliable computer, stable internet, and backup power/internet

- Willing to use time-tracking software

- A deep understanding of law is NOT required - we will train you

- Must be very organized and always meet deadlines

- Must be self-motivated, always looking for ways to 



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

- Experience with a US law firm, legal assistant, or paralegal work

- Experience with US Bankruptcy Law 

- Bookkeeping or accounting experience



WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive pay: $500–900 USD/month, paid on time, every time

- 13th-month pay every December

- Paid time off after 90 days: 5 days paid time off. Additional unpaid time off with approval. 

- 10 Paid holidays: Our U.S. firm holidays (potential to swap some US holidays with regular Philippine holidays with approval)

- Paid training on U.S. bankruptcy procedures and our systems



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

To be considered, you must do ALL three:

1. Submit a resume 

2. Submit along with a 1 page cover letter explaining why you are a good candidate. Discuss your personality and 3-5 sentences about a time your attention to detail caught an important mistake.

2. Include a link to a short (1-2 minute) video introducing yourself (Loom or Google Drive).



Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

We need someone who is highly organized, protective of brand standards, and able to run with a project without constant supervision.

-This is a night-shift schedule in the Philippines, so you must be comfortable working these hours consistently and have a quiet workspace

-Fast, reliable internet is required. You will download and upload large files every day (Cinema 4D renders, layered Photoshop and InDesign files, and print-ready artwork). A backup connection or power source is a plus



Pay:



-$8 to $10 USD per hour, depending on experience and portfolio (about $1,400 to $1,700 per month at 40 hours a week)

Long-term, full-time position



What you’ll do:



-Design ads, web kits, banners,
s, and other digital and print assets

-Create printed insert cards, mailers, signs, and large-format graphics for trade show booths

-Work on product labels, including warping graphics over bottle mockups

-Build planograms for vendors and internal teams

-Create short and long-form guides with strong typography and image layout

-Build review decks in PowerPoint and Word to present concepts

-Create 3D product renderings in Cinema 4D, from small
 graphics to full booth walls

-Create product animations

-Use AI tools to support ideation, concepts, and expanding imagery

-Coordinate with outside vendors and printers, and follow up until the job is done



What we’re looking for:



-6+ years of professional design experience, including 2+ years of 3D work

-Highly skilled in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign

-Highly skilled in Cinema 4D. Adobe Dimensions is a plus

-Understanding of lighting and photography as applied to 3D work

-Strong conceptual skills and comfort with Microsoft PowerPoint and Word

-Follows brand guidelines closely and does not deviate from them

-Works independently with little supervision

-Takes critical feedback well and communicates clearly in written and spoken English

-Highly organized and self-motivated

How to apply:



-Start your message with the words “Brand First” so we know you read this post

title: Social Media, Influencer & Email Marketing Manager
description:
This is a full-time position.  We pay well, and we do not allow anyone to take on an additional client (moonlighting) while working with us.  



Company: Southshore Fine Linens

Location: Las Vegas, NV / Remote

Position: Full-Time



About the Role



Southshore Fine Linens is looking for a hands-on, results-driven Social Media, Influencer &
 Marketing Manager to own and grow our social media presence, influencer/creator program,
 marketing, and the connection between these channels and our Shopify store.



This is not simply a content-posting position. We are looking for someone who understands how social media, influencers,
, and Shopify work together to generate traffic, customer acquisition, conversions, and revenue for an e-commerce brand.



The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience with:



TikTok and TikTok Shop

Instagram


Pinterest

X (formerly
)

Influencer and creator management

Omnisend

Shopify

Social Media Management



Own the strategy, execution, growth, and day-to-day management of Southshore Fine Linens across TikTok, Instagram,
, Pinterest, and X.



Responsibilities include:



Develop and manage the overall social media calendar.

Create platform-specific strategies rather than simply posting identical content everywhere.

Coordinate and publish Reels, Stories, posts, videos, Pins, promotional content, and other creative.

Develop content around products, promotions, launches, seasonal events, lifestyle topics, customer reviews, educational topics, and trends.

Write compelling captions, hooks, calls-to-action, and social copy.

Monitor comments, messages, mentions, and customer engagement.

Identify emerging trends and act quickly on relevant opportunities.

Repurpose successful content intelligently across platforms.

Test creative concepts, hooks, formats, posting schedules, and calls-to-action.

Grow followers and engagement while maintaining our brand voice.

Drive qualified traffic from social media to our Shopify store.

Track traffic, conversions, and revenue generated by social media.

TikTok & TikTok Shop



Candidate must understand TikTok inside and out, including:



Organic TikTok strategy

TikTok Shop

TikTok Creator and Affiliate programs

Creator outreach and recruitment

UGC content

Product seeding

Short-form video strategy

Trends, sounds, hooks, and formats

Creator commissions

Product promotions

Campaign development

TikTok analytics

Traffic and conversion tracking



The candidate should understand how to identify content with strong potential, recruit creators, develop campaigns, and turn TikTok activity into measurable sales.



Instagram,
, Pinterest & X



The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing strategies specific to each platform.



Instagram: Reels, Stories, feed posts, carousels, UGC, influencer collaborations, product content, engagement, and community building.



: Organic content, Reels, promotions, customer engagement, product content, seasonal campaigns, and coordination with Instagram and the Meta ecosystem.



Pinterest: Pins, boards, keyword optimization, Pinterest search, seasonal and evergreen content, product discovery, Shopify traffic, and conversion tracking.



X: Brand communications, product announcements, promotional content, customer engagement, relevant conversations, and timely brand messaging.



The candidate should understand that each platform requires its own audience strategy, content style, and objectives.



Influencer & Creator Management



Own and grow our influencer and creator program across social platforms.



Responsibilities include:



Identify and recruit influencers and creators who align with Southshore Fine Linens.

Conduct influencer outreach.

Negotiate collaborations, compensation, commissions, affiliate arrangements, and deliverables.

Manage creators from initial outreach through campaign completion.

Coordinate product samples and gifting.

Develop creator briefs and content requirements.

Track products sent to influencers.

Track posting deadlines and deliverables.

Manage affiliate links and promotional codes.

Monitor creator-generated traffic and sales.

Maintain an organized influencer/creator database.

Develop longer-term partnerships with high-performing creators.

Measure influencer performance based on engagement, traffic, conversions, sales, and ROI.



We want someone who understands that follower count alone does not determine the value of an influencer. The goal is to identify creators who can produce great content, reach the right customers, and influence purchasing behavior.



Omnisend &
 Marketing



Candidate must have hands-on Omnisend experience.



Responsibilities include:



Build and schedule
 campaigns.

Create promotional, product-launch, seasonal, and retention campaigns.

Build and optimize automated
 flows.

Segment customers based on purchasing and engagement behavior.

Maintain subscriber lists and list hygiene.

Grow the
 subscriber database.

Conduct A/B testing.

Optimize subject lines, offers, creative, calls-to-action, and send times.

Track
 traffic through Shopify.

Monitor conversions and revenue generated from
.

 Deliverability



Candidate must understand
 deliverability and sender reputation, including:



Greenlisting/whitelisting
 addresses and domains

SPF

DKIM

DMARC

Sender reputation

Spam complaints

Bounce rates

Inbox placement

Suppression lists

List hygiene

 authentication

Deliverability troubleshooting



The candidate should be able to identify potential deliverability problems and take appropriate steps to improve inbox placement.



Shopify & E-Commerce



Hands-on Shopify experience is required.



The candidate does not need to be a Shopify developer, but must be comfortable working inside Shopify and understand how marketing activity translates into e-commerce results.



Responsibilities and required knowledge include:



Navigate and manage the Shopify backend.

Understand products, collections, pages, navigation, and promotions.

Create and update landing pages as needed for campaigns.

Create and manage discount codes and promotional offers.

Understand Shopify customer data and segmentation.

Understand Shopify analytics and reporting.

Track traffic sources, conversions, average order value, and revenue.

Understand conversion rate and the customer purchase funnel.

Connect social campaigns to appropriate products, collections, and landing pages.

Understand integrations between Shopify, Omnisend, TikTok, Meta, Pinterest, and other marketing platforms.

Use UTMs and other tracking methods to properly attribute traffic and sales.

Review campaign performance based on actual Shopify revenue—not simply clicks and engagement.

Identify basic website or product-page issues that may be hurting conversion.

Work with other team members to improve product pages, promotions, landing pages, and customer experience.



The candidate should understand the entire customer journey:



Social/Influencer/Email → Shopify → Product Page → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Repeat Customer



Reporting & KPIs



This position will be accountable for measurable business results—not simply posting activity.



Key performance indicators will include:



Social media reach and engagement

Audience/follower growth

Video views and watch time

Website traffic from social media

Shopify sessions by marketing channel

Conversion rate

Revenue attributable to social media

TikTok Shop sales

Influencer-generated revenue

Creator conversion rates

Influencer campaign ROI

Pinterest-generated traffic

 list growth

 click-through rate

 conversion rate

-generated revenue

 deliverability

Shopify conversion rate

Average order value

New vs. returning customers

Revenue by channel



The candidate should provide regular reporting that clearly explains:



What happened?

What worked?

What didn't work?

Why?

What are we going to change or test next?



Required Experience

Demonstrated experience managing social media for an e-commerce or consumer brand.

Advanced TikTok knowledge is required.

Experience with TikTok Shop.

Experience managing Instagram,
, Pinterest, and X.

Experience managing influencers, creators, affiliates, and UGC campaigns.

Hands-on Omnisend experience is required.

Hands-on Shopify experience is required.

Knowledge of
 deliverability and greenlisting/whitelisting.

Understanding of Shopify analytics, conversions, promotions, and customer behavior.

Strong understanding of short-form video.

Strong copywriting skills.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.

Comfortable analyzing marketing data and reporting results.

Strong understanding of e-commerce conversion and customer acquisition.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of results.

What We're Looking For



We want someone who is proactive, creative, organized, accountable, analytical, and commercially minded.



You should not need to be told every day what to post or whom to contact. We expect you to actively look for trends, creators, content opportunities, and new ways to generate traffic and revenue.



You should be able to come to the team every week and say:



“Here is what happened last week, here is what worked, here is what didn't work, and here is what I recommend we do next.”



Application Requirements



Please provide the following with your application:



Social media accounts you have personally managed.

Examples of TikTok content and campaigns you personally managed.

Your experience with TikTok Shop.

Your experience with Instagram,
, Pinterest, and X.

Examples of influencer/creator campaigns you personally managed.

Your experience with Omnisend.

Your experience with
 deliverability and greenlisting/whitelisting.

Your experience managing Shopify stores.

Examples of Shopify campaigns, landing pages, promotions, or discount strategies you have managed.

Examples of measurable results you achieved, including traffic, conversions, sales, and ROI.

The KPIs you believe an e-commerce brand should review every week.



Please do not apply if your social media experience is primarily limited to creating graphics, scheduling posts, or increasing follower counts.



We are looking for someone who understands social media, influencers,
, Shopify, and e-commerce as interconnected revenue-generating functions.

title: Digital Marketing & Social Media Growth Manager | SEO, AI & Lead Generation
description:
We’re Hiring: Digital Marketing & Social Media Growth Manager



Company: Beacon of Health

Location: Remote

Employment: Gig, with potential for part-time



About Us



Beacon of Health is a growing U.S.-based telehealth practice providing convenient, affordable, personalized healthcare. Our services include medical weight management, acute care, chronic condition management, and wellness services.



We are seeking a highly skilled, creative, results-driven Digital Marketing & Social Media Growth Manager who can help us expand our online presence, improve search engine visibility, generate qualified leads, and convert those leads into actual patient appointments.



We are not looking for someone who only creates social media posts. We need someone who understands how to grow a healthcare business and deliver measurable results.



Key Responsibilities



1. Social Media Management & Content Creation



* Manage
, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant social media platforms.

* Create professional, engaging graphics, short-form videos, reels, educational posts, and promotional campaigns.

* Develop and execute a monthly content calendar.

* Write compelling captions, hooks, and calls to action that encourage appointment bookings.

* Grow authentic followers, engagement, website traffic, and qualified patient inquiries.

* Maintain consistent, professional branding across all platforms.



2. SEO & Website Optimization



* Audit and improve our Wix website

* Improve technical SEO, on-page SEO, meta descriptions, page titles, internal linking, and website performance.

* Optimize service pages for relevant medical weight management and telehealth searches.

* Improve Google Search Console indexing and visibility.

* Optimize our Google Business Profile and local SEO.

* Improve discoverability in Google and AI-powered search platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.

* Identify and resolve website issues that may prevent patients from finding or booking our services.



3. Lead Generation & Appointment Conversion



* Develop strategies that attract qualified patients who are ready to book appointments.

* Optimize website landing pages, calls to action, and appointment-booking funnels.

* Manage and improve Meta and Google advertising campaigns.

* Set up and troubleshoot conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager.

* Track appointment bookings rather than focusing only on clicks and impressions.

* Identify why potential patients are visiting our website but not completing bookings.

* Recommend and implement solutions that improve conversion rates.

* Provide measurable reports on leads, booked appointments, and marketing performance.



4. AI Integration & Automation



* Identify AI tools that can improve our practice’s marketing and administrative efficiency.

* Develop AI-assisted workflows for content creation, scheduling, patient inquiries, and approved administrative follow-ups.

* Explore website chatbots, automated lead responses, and appointment reminders.

* Recommend practical AI tools that integrate with Wix and our existing practice systems.

* Ensure patient information is protected and that any systems processing protected health information meet applicable HIPAA requirements.



5. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth



* Conduct competitor research and identify growth opportunities.

* Develop creative marketing campaigns that distinguish Beacon of Health from competing telehealth providers.

* Recommend ways to improve brand awareness, credibility, and patient acquisition.

* Monitor marketing performance and adjust strategies based on results.

* Provide proactive recommendations, not just complete assigned tasks.

* Work independently while communicating regularly with the practice owner.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Please send a Loom Video expressing your interest in this position and reviewing your experience



About the role



We're hiring a Social Media Manager to own Trade Launch's social presence end to end: the calendar, the team that produces it, and the results it drives. You report directly to the CMO, who sets the strategy. Your job is to turn that strategy into a calendar that ships on time, every day, across every channel.



Trade Launch is a business coaching company for painting contractors and home service owners. We help owners build the systems, team and sales engine to grow, drawing on the playbook behind a successful multi-million dollar painting company. Our content features our coaches, our clients and our team, and it has to sound like operators talking to operators.

We're looking for an elite, self-directed operator who can lead a small creative team, hold people accountable without being chased, and still jump in to edit and post themselves when it matters.



At a glance



Reports to: CMO

Manages: a content coordinator/scheduler and video editors 

Channels: Instagram,
, YouTube, TikTok, plus LinkedIn and others as they become relevant

Location: Remote (international candidates welcome)

Hours: Full-time, US Eastern business hours



What you'll own



The content calendar, through and through

Build and maintain a rolling monthly calendar at least 60 days ahead, mapped to our content pillars and funnel stages (top: reach, middle: educate, bottom: act).

Track every post from idea to published: footage status (have vs. need), editor assigned, draft, review, approval, scheduled, live.

Fold launches and campaigns into the calendar without being asked: webinars, events and conferences, course updates, client-story series, promotions.

Execution of the strategy

Take the CMO's high-level strategy (pillars, funnel mix, goals) and turn it into a channel-by-channel plan, formats, hooks and briefs.

Write clear editing briefs: the angle, the hook, the cut, reference examples, length and format per platform.

Repurpose long-form content (coaching calls, webinars, client stories, event footage) into short-form clips, carousels and posts across channels.

Write captions, hooks and on-screen text in the Trade Launch brand voice: confident, practical, operator-to-operator, never gimmicky.

People and production

Lead the content coordinator and video editors day to day: assign work, set deadlines, review quality and give direct feedback.

Run a weekly production meeting and send a weekly report (see Success below).

Chase content from coaches, leadership and our videographer: request footage, book filming, collect raw files and keep the pipeline full.

Resolve priority conflicts before they stall work

Hands-on creation

Edit short-form video yourself when it's faster or the bar is higher

Performance and growth

Own social KPIs: reach, follower growth, engagement, watch time, saves and shares, and leads or calls sourced from social.

Spot trends early and bring recommendations on what to test, kill or double down on. Trends only make the cut when they fit how Trade Launch operates.

Evaluate new channels and propose a plan when one is worth adding.



How success is measured



You'll be measured on output first, then results. In the first 90 days, success means the backlog is gone, the calendar is always 30 days ahead, and leadership no longer has to ask where anything stands.

title: Data Research Virtual Assistant (Address Locator)
description:
Pavilion is a national collection of local vacation rental companies, bringing together 5,000 vacation homes under one roof with expert local care backed by national strength. Maui Paradise Properties is one of Pavilion's local brands, led by a Maui-based team with deep knowledge of the island.







Job Description: Data Research Virtual Assistant (Address Locator)

Oct 21, 2026 

Role summary

We need a detail-obsessed research VA to find the exact street address and unit number of vacation rental listings our automated scraper could not resolve. 15-20 hours a week.

Company: a multi-brand vacation rental management company with markets on Florida's Emerald Coast / 30A, the Grand Strand (Myrtle Beach) and Kiawah Island, SC, and Telluride, CO.

Why this role exists: our data pipeline pulls Airbnb/VRBO listings, resolves the address, then finds the owner for outreach. Automation handles roughly 60 to 70% of listings. The rest need a human: fuzzy map pins, hidden addresses, stacked condos, unit numbers only visible in photos.

What success looks like: every unresolved listing comes back with a verified address and unit number, or a clear "not findable" note with what was tried.

Reports to: Gabriella Riska (Regional Director of Business Development) and Adam (Growth/Data).

Core responsibilities

The job is one loop: take an unresolved listing, find the property, prove it, log it.

Work the exception queue. Pull listings the scraper flagged as unmatched (Airbnb, VRBO, or competitor direct-booking links) from a shared sheet or the CRM.

Locate the property. Use the listing text, photos, map pin, reviews and host info to pinpoint the building or home (methods below).

Pin down the unit number. For condos, read unit numbers from door photos, view angles, floor plans, balcony position and building layout. Stacked condos are the hardest and most valuable part of this job.

Verify against public records. Confirm the address and owner name in the county property appraiser / tax records.

Log results in a consistent format. Address, unit, complex name, confidence level (Confirmed / Likely / Not found), method used, and a short note on evidence.

Backfill high-value targets on request. Large homes, specific complexes, or a competitor's listings where the scraper missed units.

Flag patterns. If one management company always hides addresses the same way, tell us so engineering can fix the scraper.

Optional, as the role grows: owner contact lookups (phone,
, mailing address) via skip-trace tools, and basic CRM data cleanup.

Research methods the VA must master

Training is three Loom walkthroughs; the hire should be able to repeat each method without supervision by the end of week one.



Must have

Proven skill with Google Maps satellite view, Street View and Google Lens / reverse image search

Comfort navigating US county property appraiser and tax record sites

Strong visual detail: spotting a unit number on a door, matching a pool shape or balcony railing across photos

Clean, consistent spreadsheet work in Google Sheets

Written English good enough to log clear evidence notes

Self-directed: works a queue without hand-holding and knows when to stop and mark "not found"

Nice to have

Vacation rental, Airbnb/VRBO or US real estate experience

Familiarity with HubSpot or another CRM

Experience with skip-trace or people-search tools (e.g. BatchData, TruePeopleSearch)

Knowledge of Florida and South Carolina coastal markets

Tools used

Research: Airbnb, VRBO, competitor direct-booking sites, Google Maps (satellite + Street View), Google Lens, Zillow / 

Verification: county property appraiser and tax record portals (logins provided where needed)

Tracking: Google Sheets exception queue, HubSpot CRM, Slack for questions

Training: Loom walkthrough videos

Optional enrichment: OwnerPoint, BatchData, TruePeopleSearch

*An exceptional verbal communicator with the highest level of English fluency, a strong command of the English language, clear pronunciation, and excellent conversational skills. This is someone who MUST speak English like Americans.

*Confident and comfortable initiating conversations with business owners who are unfamiliar with our company.

*Skilled at building rapport quickly, asking thoughtful questions, and identifying potential customer needs.

*Experienced in handling objections and guiding conversations toward scheduling appointments.

*Self-motivated and capable of working independently without constant supervision or direction.

*Persistent, resilient, and able to maintain enthusiasm and professionalism when facing rejection.

*Highly organized and disciplined about managing follow-ups and maintaining accurate CRM records.

*Comfortable working toward daily and weekly calling and appointment-setting goals.

*Experienced using CRM systems, calling software, and other sales technology.

*Coachable, adaptable, and willing to continually refine their approach based on results and feedback.

*Experience following up with webinar attendees, event participants, and other warm leads.

Introduce Shop Marketing Pros and communicate the value of our digital marketing services.

Engage prospects in meaningful conversations to identify business needs and potential sales opportunities.

Qualify prospects and schedule discovery appointments for our sales team.

Follow up with prospects who have attended webinars, classes, conferences, and other company events.

Contact prospective clients to promote upcoming webinars, educational opportunities, and company events.

Consistently follow up with interested prospects to convert initial conversations into scheduled appointments.

Maintain accurate records of calls, prospect information, conversations, appointments, and follow-up activities within our CRM.

Work efficiently through provided prospect lists while prioritizing follow-up opportunities.

Meet established daily and weekly performance expectations for calls, conversations, and qualified appointments.

Collaborate with the sales team to refine calling scripts, messaging, and objection-handling techniques.

Communicate prospect feedback, common objections, and emerging opportunities to the sales team.

title: Youtube VIdeo Editor
description:
YouTube Video Editor

Dollars & Sense/ TBD is seeking a creative, detail-oriented, and highly reliable Full-Time YouTube Video Editor to take ownership of our post-production workflow.

We are launching a professional, high-leverage channel focused on business, personal finance, macroeconomics, and real estate asset management. This role is ideal for a mid-to-senior level editor who understands YouTube-native pacing, audience retention strategies, and how to turn complex financial data or talking-head footage into clean, engaging visual narratives.

________________________________________

📋 Key Responsibilities

• End-to-End Editing: Edit 1 to 2 high-quality long-form videos per week (typically 8–30+ minutes) using Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

• Retention-Focused Pacing: Execute sharp cuts, intentional framing changes, and seamless transitions to maintain high viewer retention.

• Data Visualization & Motion Graphics: Create clean charts, map highlights, on-screen text animations, and callouts to simplify complex economic and financial metrics.

• Audio & Sound Design: Blend high-quality background tracks, master vocal clarity, and implement crisp sound effects (SFX) that accent transitions without distracting from the content.

• B-Roll & Asset Sourcing: Autonomously select and overlay premium, relevant stock footage, custom diagrams, or provided b-roll to keep the narrative visually dynamic.

• Daily Reporting & Communication: Provide simple, clear daily
 updates outlining what was accomplished and what tasks are next on your queue to ensure a predictable production pipeline.

________________________________________

🛠 Required Skills & Qualifications

• Experience: 2+ years of proven experience editing native YouTube content (portfolio/showreel showcasing long-form pacing is mandatory).

• Software Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, alongside a strong working knowledge of After Effects for custom motion graphics.

• Aesthetic Standard: A clean, modern, and professional editing style—relying on smooth, functional transitions rather than over-the-top or chaotic kid-vlog edits.

• Technical Setup: Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a powerful workstation capable of handling fast rendering timelines and multi-cam footage.

• Independence & Structure: Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage file structures, project backups, and cross-reference a shared knowledge base or style guide independently.

________________________________________

💼 Job Details & Compensation

• Position Type: Full-Time, Remote (Direct Hire / Freelance Contract).

• Schedule: Flexible hours, but requires a 2 hour daily overlap window for operational alignment and brief status updates.

• Compensation: $800 – $1,500 USD per month, scaling dynamically based on experience, speed, and motion graphics capability.

title: Staffing Coordinator
description:
Job Description: Staffing Coordinator

Summary: The Staffing Coordinator plays a pivotal role within the agency. They are responsible for much of the recruiting, interviewing, hiring, orienting, training, competency assessments, mentoring, scheduling, and accurately maintaining employee files of Caregivers for the agency. Together with the Care Manager, they supervise Caregivers to ensure that policies and procedures are being adhered to and implement the appropriate corrective action when necessary. In addition, they assist in answering incoming client and referral phone calls, develop rapport with the caller, explain agency services, answer questions, and schedule in-home appointments for the Community Liaison.

Minimum Eligibility Requirements:

• Knowledgeable about client care issues and care-giving skills

• Ability to supervise, train, verify competencies of, and schedule other employees

• Willingness to learn HR Policies

. Fluent in English both speaking & writing

• Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills

• Basic computer knowledge, data entry, word processing.

• Finalize billing in WellSky for each caregiver visit

• Monitor Care Academy training to insure employees are up to date with current training

• Pass a criminal background check

• During office hours we will be live on Microsoft teams, zoom or another live video platform.

. Familiar with software WellSky is a plus

Essential Functions:

• Staffing cases with competent Caregivers who are a good match for the client, based on information gathered from the Care Manager. This means locating a Personal Assistant who matches the skills level and certifications needed for the care of the client (i.e. lifting capabilities, experience with dementia, states licensing if required by a facility, etc). A match should also be made that fits with the Personal Assistant’s availability and whether they can do hourly or “live-in” shifts.

• Maintaining an accurate and current schedule of services for all clients in WellSky

• Continually recruit and hire new employees consistent with agency goals, to maintain pool of eligible Caregivers.

• Creating and posting of employment advertisements

• Reviewing applications

• Telephone screening calls

• Verifying work and personal references

• Conducting Interviews

• Conduct orientation of caregivers. This includes ensuring that all new hires complete required forms, verification of skills and/or training, and orientation to current policies and procedures.

• Ensuring that criminal background checks are run on a Personal Assistant in accordance with the state rule.

• Creating and maintaining personnel records that include:

• Current certifications, credentials or licensure as required by state and agency policies

• Employee application

• Documentation of interview and verified references

• Evidence of disclosure statement and criminal background checks

• Evidence of orientation to agency policies and procedures

• Verification of skills and/or training to meet client care needs

• Training on current and revised policies and procedures, as needed

• Documentation of performance reviews and on-site visits

• Ensuring that personnel information is up-to-date in personnel record. This includes contact information such as phone number(s), address, and
; availability; certifications; onsite evaluations; safety meetings; and performance reviews. Contact Caregivers to request, and receive, current information and/or copies of current certifications.

• Acting as the liaison for the caregivers with the agency. Developing a good rapport with the caregivers and caring for their well-being. Listening to any concerns they may have and taking action if necessary. Mentoring Caregivers, through calls or visits, to make sure things are going well on cases and that they feel supported by the agency. In short, being the “Caregiver of the caregivers.”

• Evaluating Caregivers on a periodic basis (on-site evaluations must be done every six months) and keeping a record of the assessments in their files.

• Contacting caregivers placed on assignment each month to inquire about safety concerns and completing and filing the appropriate form. If Caregives disclose any safety concerns, working with the Care Manager and/or Administrator to resolve.

• Communicating with clients and families about concerns with Caregivers or changes in scheduling and/or staffing.

• Ensuring that HomeWell policies and procedures are being adhered to by all Caregivers and implementing the appropriate corrective action when necessary

• Documenting events in WellSky; ensuring that all staffing related events are resolved in a timely manner; and, when needed, assisting with the resolution of other non-staffing events.

• Working in conjunction with the Administrator to make sure operations in the agency run smoothly. This includes, but is not limited to, answering phone calls, taking client service inquiries, greeting office visitors, ensuring proper equipment and supplies are functional and in stock, running errands and miscellaneous filing.

• Intake of client services inquiries, including consulting caller and gathering data, sending information to potential client, logging the inquiry in the system, alerting Care Manager of potential services, and setting appointments for consultations and assessments.

• Staffing client shifts when Caregivers are unable to go to work, or do not show up to work.

• Participate in, and take call in, after-hour administration call rotation

• Maintaining HomeWell of Salt Lake County’s status as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Keeping the Administrator aware of staffing and Personal Assistant issues.

• Reports to the Administrator

Additional Duties:

• Attend staff meetings

• Support the Care Manager, including but not limited to conducting Client-Personal Assistant introductions, assessments, dropping off care plans and/or timesheets, and processing client paperwork.

• Assist with office operations, as needed. This includes, but is not limited to, answering phones, greeting office visitors, taking service inquires, printing forms, creating packets of forms and miscellaneous filing.

• Basic cross-training in other roles of the business, so can assist as needed and directed by the Administrator

• Maintain stock of printed forms and documents, including but not limited to employee applications, orientation packets, client assessment packets, address labels, fax forms, office timesheets and expense reports.

Job Description: After-Hours Administration Call

Summary: The after-hours emergency contact is responsible for handling client care and staffing emergencies during all non-business hours.

Minimum Eligibility Requirements:

• Available during evenings, early mornings, weekends and office holidays to take calls and respond to urgent situations

• Experience and/or familiarity with in-home care services preferred

• Professional phone demeanor

• Ability to effectively react to urgent situations and manage upset callers

• Ability to document and relay detailed information

• Ability to read maps and provide directions

Essential Functions:

• Alerting family and/or Caregivers of client emergencies that will impact delivery of services, such as cancellation of services, change in client condition, hospitalization, or death.

.

• Maintaining basic and current knowledge of HomeWell clients and Caregivers, including scheduling and care needs of clients and PA skills and availability. Will require ongoing communication and updates with the HomeWell office, as well as periodic review of the management software.

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIP:

The Staffing Coordinator reports directly to the Administrator.
