title: Head of Marketing
description:
# Head of Marketing & Agent Growth



**Company:** Confidential Real Estate Brokerage

**Department:** Marketing & Agent Growth

**Reports To:** CEO

**Location:** Remote, with occasional travel for meetings, trainings, and events

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Compensation:** Base salary plus performance-based compensation tied to marketing services revenue, client growth, retention, and agreed marketing outcomes.



## About the Company



The Company is a growing, relationship-first real estate brokerage focused on helping agents build stronger and more sustainable businesses through leadership, coaching, marketing, technology, AI, systems, and community.



The Marketing Services Division provides done-for-you marketing and personal-brand support to help agents stay visible, build relationships, strengthen their brands, and generate new business opportunities.



## About the Role



The Head of Marketing & Agent Growth will lead the Company’s overall marketing strategy, support agents with their individual marketing needs, and drive the growth of the Marketing Services Division.



This is a strategic, relationship-driven, and revenue-focused role — not primarily a graphic design or production position.



The person in this role will work directly with agents to understand their businesses, identify marketing opportunities, recommend solutions, introduce appropriate marketing services, guide agents through the sales process, and oversee onboarding and fulfillment coordination.



## Key Responsibilities



### Marketing Strategy & Brand Leadership



* Develop and manage the Company’s overall marketing strategy.

* Create marketing plans that support recruiting, agent retention, training, company growth, culture, and brand awareness.

* Strengthen the Company’s positioning, messaging, and brand voice.

* Turn company goals into campaigns, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

* Lead campaign strategy, messaging, copywriting, and creative direction.

* Maintain marketing, content, training, and event calendars.

* Review campaign performance and recommend improvements.

* Ensure consistent branding across websites, email, social media, community platforms, YouTube, presentations, and agent communications.



### Agent Marketing & Relationship Management



* Serve as the primary marketing point of contact for agents.

* Build relationships through calls, meetings, trainings, events, and proactive outreach.

* Proactively reach out to agents instead of waiting for marketing requests.

* Understand each agent’s business, goals, challenges, market, budget, and marketing activity.

* Conduct marketing consultations, brand audits, website reviews, and strategy sessions.

* Identify gaps in branding, websites, social media, databases, content, and follow-up systems.

* Recommend practical marketing priorities based on each agent’s goals and resources.

* Help agents improve their personal brand, content, email marketing, websites, social media, and database marketing.

* Follow up after consultations and help agents take action.

* Share recurring agent feedback and needs with leadership.



### Marketing Services Sales & Growth



* Lead the growth strategy for the Marketing Services Division.

* Understand all available services, pricing, deliverables, timelines, and processes.

* Introduce agents to marketing services through consultations, email, trainings, webinars, events, and direct outreach.

* Conduct discovery calls to understand agent needs.

* Recommend services based on the agent’s goals, budget, and marketing needs.

* Clearly explain services, pricing, timelines, responsibilities, and expectations.

* Confidently ask for the business when there is a strong fit.

* Follow up with prospects and move opportunities through the sales process.

* Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects, proposals, enrollments, active clients, renewals, and cancellations.

* Identify upsell and expansion opportunities with existing clients.

* Track leads, conversions, revenue, retention, and cancellations.



### Client Onboarding



* Own the onboarding experience for new marketing services clients.

* Welcome new clients and explain next steps.

* Confirm agreements, payments, services, timelines, responsibilities, and communication expectations.

* Collect required information, files, brand assets, and account access.

* Set up projects, tasks, deadlines, owners, and workflows in 
.

* Coordinate kickoff meetings and handoffs to the fulfillment team.

* Monitor the first stages of service delivery.

* Check in with clients during their first 30 days.

* Address onboarding concerns and coordinate solutions.

* Maintain organized client records and improve onboarding systems when needed.



### New Agent Marketing Onboarding



* Participate in the onboarding of newly affiliated agents.

* Introduce agents to available marketing tools, resources, trainings, templates, and support.

* Explain what is included with the brokerage and what is available separately through marketing services.

* Conduct an initial marketing assessment for each new agent.

* Identify the top marketing priorities they should focus on first.

* Coordinate agent bios, headshots, profiles, websites, welcome campaigns, and announcements when needed.

* Follow up after onboarding to encourage adoption and identify additional needs.



### Content, Messaging & Storytelling



* Lead messaging and content strategy for major company initiatives.

* Develop copy and messaging for recruiting, training, agent recognition, culture, announcements, and marketing services.

* Turn leadership ideas into campaigns, emails, scripts, website copy, presentations, and marketing briefs.

* Develop agent stories, success stories, and recognition content.

* Maintain a consistent, clear, personal, and human brand voice.



### Training & Event Marketing



* Lead marketing for trainings, webinars, workshops, meetings, and company events.

* Manage the training and event marketing calendar.

* Develop promotional messaging, registration campaigns, reminders, and follow-up communication.

* Coordinate graphics, presentations, landing pages, emails, social posts, and other event materials.

* Track registrations, attendance, participation, and feedback.



### Websites & Digital Platforms



* Oversee website strategy, structure, messaging, and content.

* Coordinate website updates, landing pages, agent pages, recruiting pages, and service pages.

* Maintain accurate information about services, pricing, processes, testimonials, FAQs, and calls to action.

* Improve website user experience and lead-generation opportunities.

* Coordinate advanced development or integrations with appropriate specialists.

* Ensure website leads are captured, tracked, and followed up.



### Community, YouTube & Agent Communication



* Manage the strategy and organization of the Company’s online agent community.

* Determine which trainings, resources, announcements, stories, and updates should be shared.

* Encourage agent participation through useful content and personal outreach.

* Oversee the Company’s YouTube content strategy.

* Coordinate video editing, thumbnails, uploads, titles, descriptions, and publishing with the production team.

* Coordinate messaging across email, community platforms, social media, meetings, and other channels.



### Marketing Operations & Project Management



* Build and manage marketing workflows in 
.

* Coordinate marketing projects from request through completion.

* Ensure every project has a clear owner, deadline, purpose, status, and next step.

* Coordinate designers, editors, website specialists, virtual assistants, contractors, and vendors.

* Manage revisions, approvals, missing information, and project communication.

* Build repeatable systems for campaigns, onboarding, trainings, websites, and recurring marketing activities.

* Document processes so work can be delegated and scaled.

* Monitor team capacity and identify bottlenecks.

* Maintain quality standards without becoming the main production person.



### Agent Engagement & Retention



* Create initiatives that help agents feel recognized, supported, and connected.

* Develop welcome campaigns, milestone recognition, anniversaries, success stories, and community highlights.

* Identify disengaged agents and coordinate thoughtful outreach.

* Gather feedback about marketing support, trainings, communication, and services.

* Recommend improvements that increase agent satisfaction, participation, productivity, and retention.



## Role Boundaries



The Head of Marketing & Agent Growth is responsible for strategy, relationships, sales, onboarding, coordination, and quality — not being the Company’s primary production person.



### This Role Owns



* Marketing strategy and brand direction.

* Agent marketing relationships and consultations.

* Agent outreach and marketing assessments.

* Marketing services discovery and sales conversations.

* Sales pipeline management and growth.

* Client onboarding.

* New-agent marketing onboarding.

* Campaign planning and creative direction.

* Copywriting and messaging.

* Training and event marketing.

* Website strategy and messaging.

* Marketing systems and workflows.

* Project coordination and team direction.

* Quality control and reporting.



### This Role May Coordinate but Does Not Need to Personally Execute



* High-volume graphic design.

* Logo design.

* Daily Canva production.

* Video editing and animation.

* Advanced website development.

* Daily social media posting.

* Photography and videography.

* Large-scale content repurposing.

* Routine client fulfillment.

* Technical integrations.

* Repetitive administrative production.



The goal is to hire a marketing and growth leader — not a production coordinator handling every flyer, website edit, or social media request.



## Required Qualifications



* 5+ years of experience in marketing, account management, business development, consultative sales, real estate, or a related field.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience developing marketing strategies, campaigns, messaging, and content.

* Strong relationship-building and client-facing experience.

* Experience conducting discovery calls, consultations, assessments, or sales conversations.

* Comfortable proactively reaching out to agents and asking for the business when appropriate.

* Strong project management and organizational skills.

* Experience managing multiple projects, clients, stakeholders, team members, or contractors.

* Strong copywriting, storytelling, editing, and messaging skills.

* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

* Ability to work independently and follow through without constant supervision.

* Comfortable balancing relationship-building with revenue and performance expectations.

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving remote environment.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience in real estate, a brokerage, real estate team, marketing agency, coaching company, or membership organization.

* Knowledge of real estate agent marketing, personal branding, recruiting, retention, database marketing, and lead generation.

* Experience selling marketing, branding, website, consulting, or content services.

* Experience onboarding clients into recurring service packages.

* Familiarity with Lofty, Squarespace, 
, Circle, Canva, CRM systems, email marketing platforms, and social media tools.

* Experience managing virtual assistants, designers, developers, editors, contractors, or creative teams.

* Basic website management experience.

* Experience tracking marketing, sales, engagement, retention, and revenue metrics.

* Experience using AI for research, writing, planning, content development, analysis, or workflow improvement.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is strategic, proactive, relationship-driven, and commercially aware.



They can develop a company-wide marketing strategy while also speaking directly with an individual agent about their business and marketing needs.



They proactively reach out, identify opportunities, recommend solutions, follow up, and ensure commitments are completed.



They are comfortable conducting consultations, recommending services, asking for the sale, onboarding clients, and coordinating a fulfillment team.



They understand that marketing is not simply creating graphics or posting content. Marketing should strengthen relationships, communicate value, generate opportunities, and support measurable business outcomes.



## Key Performance Measures



* Agent conversations and marketing consultations.

* Consultation follow-up completion.

* New-agent marketing onboarding completion.

* Agent satisfaction and engagement.

* Marketing services discovery calls and proposals.

* Discovery-to-enrollment conversion rate.

* New recurring and one-time revenue.

* Active clients, retention, renewals, and cancellations.

* Client onboarding completion and first-30-day experience.

* Marketing campaign performance.

* Training registrations and attendance.

* Email, website, and community engagement.

* On-time project completion.

* Quality and organization of marketing workflows.

* Development of repeatable marketing systems.



## First 90 Days



### First 30 Days — Learn & Audit



* Learn the Company’s business model, brand, agents, systems, services, and culture.

* Meet with leadership, operations, recruiting, brokerage, marketing team members, and agents.

* Review current websites, campaigns, emails, social media, community platforms, YouTube, and marketing workflows.

* Learn all marketing services, pricing, processes, and fulfillment standards.

* Review the sales pipeline, active clients, onboarding process, and fulfillment workflows.

* Identify immediate marketing, sales, onboarding, communication, and operational gaps.

* Establish baseline performance metrics.



### Days 31–60 — Build the Foundation



* Establish a consistent agent outreach and consultation process.

* Create a repeatable marketing audit and recommendation process.

* Improve the marketing services sales pipeline and tracking system.

* Document client onboarding and handoff processes.

* Establish marketing, content, training, and communication calendars.

* Improve how marketing resources and services are introduced to agents.

* Begin consistent proactive agent outreach.

* Identify priority campaigns for recruiting, retention, training, culture, and revenue growth.



### Days 61–90 — Launch & Improve



* Present and execute a prioritized quarterly marketing plan.

* Launch priority marketing and growth campaigns.

* Begin reporting marketing, sales, agent engagement, and revenue metrics.

* Recommend improvements to services, positioning, onboarding, fulfillment, and client experience.

* Establish a consistent reporting process.

* Clarify responsibilities across strategy, sales, onboarding, project management, and production.

* Identify additional staffing, contractor, system, or training needs.

* Provide leadership with a clear assessment of what is working, what needs improvement, and recommended next steps.

title: Competitive Insights Analyst (Part-Time) | Transcend
description:
Company: Transcend (
)

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Type: Part-time, ongoing

Hours: 20-25 hours per week, with a flexible schedule (daily reviews required)

Pay: $7-$10 USD per hour, paid bi-weekly through our payroll system

Meetings: One weekly check-in to review findings and priorities



About the Role



We’re hiring a detail-focused Competitive Insights Analyst to be our eyes on the market. Every day you’ll review what 8 competitors and internet dealers are promoting, record the offers and prices they’re sending out, and flag any pricing that breaks our Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) policy. You’ll build and maintain a Google Sheets tracker that logs every offer over time, and you’ll turn that data into clear daily and weekly reports we can act on. This is a long-term role for someone who is organized, thorough, and dependable.



About Transcend



Transcend is a US-based medical device company. We make the Transcend Micro and Micro 510, the smallest and lightest FDA-cleared portable CPAP machines, and we sell through our own Shopify store at 
 and through dealers and resellers.



What You’ll Do

Review the social media accounts 
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn) of 8 competitors and internet dealers

Monitor their newsletters and promotional
s, text message offers, and websites (homepage banners, product pages, pop-ups, and promo codes)

Build and maintain a Google Sheets tracker that records every offer by date: competitor or dealer, channel, product, advertised price, discount, promo code, bundle contents, start and end dates, and source link

Capture a screenshot or link as proof for every offer and attach it to the tracker

Compare advertised prices against our MAP policy and flag any violations with evidence

Track offers and prices over time, so we can see how prices and promotions change by competitor, product, and week

Deliver a daily recap by end of day (an updated tracker plus a short written summary of key changes, new promotions, and violations)

Build weekly and monthly reports in Google Sheets using pivot tables, charts, and summaries (who is discounting, which products, how deep, how often, and repeat MAP violators)

Keep a running violation log with dates, evidence, and status

Spot new competitors, new products, and changes in competitors’ messaging or promotions

Join a weekly meeting to review findings and next steps

Requirements

At least 1-2 years of experience in research, competitive analysis, e-commerce, marketing, or a similar detail-heavy role

Strong, hands-on Google Sheets skills. You must be able to build a spreadsheet from scratch, including:

Organized tabs and consistent data entry (dropdowns, data validation, date and currency formatting)

Formulas such as SUMIF, COUNTIF, VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, IF, and AVERAGEIF

Filters, sorting, conditional formatting (for example, highlighting MAP violations)

Pivot tables and charts to summarize trends over time

Sharing and collaboration settings

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy with prices, dates, and promo terms

Strong written English, with the ability to summarize findings clearly and briefly

Able to follow a daily routine, meet deadlines, and work independently

Comfortable using social platforms,
, and text to monitor accounts

Reliable internet and a computer

Able to keep our pricing and findings strictly confidential

Able to work 20-25 hours per week, with daily check-ins every day of the work week

Able to overlap with US hours when needed, and to join a weekly meeting during US Central Time hours

Nice to Have

Experience with Google Sheets automation (Apps Script, IMPORTXML, or similar), or with Looker Studio dashboards

Experience with MAP policy monitoring, pricing compliance, or brand protection

Experience with e-commerce, Shopify, or health or medical products

Familiarity with screenshot, price-tracking, or social listening tools

This opportunity is ideal for someone who can work independently, manage multiple assignments, maintain high-quality standards, and consistently deliver accurate work within agreed timelines.



Job Details

As a US Tax Preparer & Bookkeeper, you will manage tax preparation and bookkeeping responsibilities for multiple clients, maintain organized documentation, and support efficient accounting workflows. Your work will play a key role in ensuring compliance, financial accuracy, and a seamless tax preparation process for our clients.

You will initially undergo a partial onboarding and testing phase designed to evaluate your technical skills, accuracy, quality of work, efficiency, and ability to meet established performance expectations.

The testing phase may include practical assignments involving actual tax and bookkeeping scenarios. The workload will be based on assigned tasks and business needs and will not necessarily require a full five-day workload.



What You'll Be Doing

Tax Preparation & Compliance

Prepare Individual Tax Returns (Form 1040) and related schedules.

Prepare Business Tax Returns, including Forms 1120, 1120S, and 1065.

Prepare Sole Proprietorship, Partnership, LLC, S Corporation, and C Corporation tax returns.

Prepare and file nonprofit tax returns, including IRS Form 990-EZ and the full IRS Form 990, while ensuring compliance with nonprofit tax regulations.

Prepare and file state and franchise tax returns in accordance with applicable state requirements.

Review financial records to ensure accuracy, completeness, and tax readiness.

Identify missing information and communicate with clients or internal team members as needed.

Maintain organized digital tax workpapers and supporting documentation.

Assist with complex, amended, and specialized tax returns as assigned.

Support year-round tax, bookkeeping, and payroll-related client needs.

Bookkeeping & Financial Management

Perform bookkeeping using QuickBooks Online.

Categorize financial transactions accurately.

Reconcile bank accounts and credit card statements.

Clean up and correct incomplete or inaccurate bookkeeping records when necessary.

Prepare monthly financial reports, including Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

Maintain accurate accounting records and ensure clients' books remain tax-ready throughout the year.



Data Entry & Administrative Support

Perform accurate data entry and document management.

Upload and organize client files using consistent naming conventions and folder structures.

Track assignments and meet internal deadlines.

Assist with administrative support related to accounting and tax operations.

Maintain confidentiality and proper handling of client financial information.



Systems & Process Improvement

Follow established workflows, SOPs, and internal checklists.

Create or update process documentation when needed.

Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen internal processes, and reduce errors.

Adapt to new accounting, tax, and productivity tools as required.

Work collaboratively with the team while maintaining the ability to work independently.



What You Bring to the Role

Proven experience preparing US Individual Income Tax Returns (Form 1040) and Business Tax Returns, including Sole Proprietorships, Partnerships, LLCs, S Corporations, and C Corporations.

Experience preparing and filing nonprofit tax returns, including IRS Form 990. Experience with both Form 990-EZ and the full Form 990 is highly preferred, along with the ability to independently prepare nonprofit filings.

Experience preparing and filing state and franchise tax returns, with an understanding of franchise tax compliance requirements in one or more US states.

Strong bookkeeping experience, including monthly bookkeeping, account reconciliations, financial record maintenance, bookkeeping cleanups, and preparation of financial statements.

Experience managing bookkeeping and tax preparation for multiple clients or businesses simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.



Proficiency with QuickBooks Online.

Experience using professional US tax software such as TaxSlayer, Drake, ProSeries, UltraTax, Lacerte, TaxAct Professional, or similar platforms.

Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and organizational skills.

Excellent time management with the ability to prioritize competing deadlines.

Ability to work independently while maintaining consistent communication with the team.

A commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work and maintaining client confidentiality.

Willingness to learn, adapt, and contribute to a growing, process-driven organization.



Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience working with a US accounting, bookkeeping, CPA, or tax preparation firm.

Experience preparing multiple nonprofit tax returns annually.

Experience handling franchise tax filings for multiple states.

Strong understanding of GAAP-based bookkeeping principles.

Experience developing or improving accounting workflows and documentation.

Experience supporting payroll and year-round accounting services.

Experience working with complex or amended tax returns.



What You Can Expect

Starting Rate: $6.00/hour equivalent or an agreed project-based rate, depending on the assignment.

Performance Review: Evaluation after 90 days of collaboration, where applicable.

Compensation Growth: Opportunity for a rate increase based on technical competency, accuracy, reliability, efficiency, and overall contribution.

Flexible Engagement: No fixed daily working hours or mandatory five-day workweek.

Task-Based Compensation: Payment based on agreed assignments, completed deliverables, or approved project milestones.

Recurring Opportunities: Possibility of receiving regular or recurring tax preparation and bookkeeping assignments.

Professional Exposure: Opportunities to work on individual, business, nonprofit, and multi-state tax matters.

Independent Work Environment: Flexibility to manage your working schedule while meeting agreed deadlines and quality standards.

Performance-Based Growth: Opportunities to handle more complex assignments and higher-value projects as your capabilities develop.

Long-Term Collaboration: Potential for continued engagement as client volume and business requirements expand.



Initial Testing & Evaluation

Our selection process prioritizes demonstrated technical ability and actual work output.

The process includes:

Application review.

Initial interview or technical assessment, if necessary.

Paid production-based testing involving actual tax preparation and bookkeeping scenarios.

Evaluation based on:

Technical knowledge and competency.

Accuracy and completeness of work.

Quality of tax returns and bookkeeping deliverables.

Attention to detail.

Efficiency and adherence to agreed deadlines.

Ability to follow instructions and established procedures.

Communication and responsiveness.

Ability to work independently.

Approval for potential ongoing assignments.

Testing assignments will be selected based on the candidate's experience and current business requirements. The candidate will not necessarily be required to complete a full five-day workload during this phase. Once assigned tasks are completed, the candidate may conclude their work for the day.

System access may initially be provided on a limited basis during the testing and evaluation process.

Successful completion of the paid testing phase may lead to additional assignments and longer-term collaboration.



About the Company

We are a growing accounting and tax services company focused on providing accurate, reliable, and efficient support to individuals, businesses, and nonprofit organizations. Our goal is to build a strong remote team that values integrity, accountability, attention to detail, and continuous improvement.

We believe in building long-term relationships with both our clients and our team members while creating opportunities for professional growth and career development.

If you have proven US tax preparation and bookkeeping experience and are looking for a long-term remote opportunity where you can grow your skills, contribute to a growing team, and take on greater responsibilities based on performance, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior DTC Video Ads Editor | Full-Time Remote
description:
About Us



FDYS is a media-led outdoor, fishing and lifestyle business operating across multiple e-commerce verticals.



Across our brands, our YouTube channels have more than 3.7 million subscribers. Content is at the centre of what we do. It grows the audience, builds community and drives e-commerce demand.



As we scale our e-commerce brands, we’re looking for an experienced DTC video ads editor to join our team full time.



About the Role



This role is focused on editing video ads. It is not a general video editing, social media or YouTube editing role. We’re looking for a senior editor who has edited ads for DTC brands doing over USD $1M per month, and who understands what makes a video work as an ad.



You’ll be fully dedicated to FDYS and edit video ads across our e-commerce brands for Meta, TikTok, TikTok Shop and YouTube. You know what makes people stop scrolling, keep watching and click. You can take a brief and raw footage and turn it into a clean, engaging ad, then create the variations we need for testing.



If you’ve edited ads for outdoor, fashion or apparel brands (think the style and feel of Patagonia, The North Face and similar), you’ll feel right at home here.



Non-Negotiables



Please only apply if you meet all of the following:



At least 4 years of experience editing paid social video ads for DTC e-commerce brands.

Experience editing ads for at least one DTC brand doing over USD $1M per month in revenue (you must name the brand or brands in your application).

Proven skill in editing high-quality video ads for Meta 
 and Instagram), with examples in your portfolio.

Experience editing ads for outdoor (including fishing or adventure), fashion or apparel brands.

A portfolio of real, live paid ads, not general video edits.

Availability to work full time and be fully dedicated to FDYS (no other ongoing clients or jobs).

Availability to work 40 hours per week, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM AEST (including a 1-hour break), with no exceptions.

An updated, high-performance laptop or computer that can handle 4K footage and heavy editing smoothly (recent processor, at least 16GB RAM, SSD storage, and a dedicated graphics card or Apple Silicon chip).

A fast and reliable internet connection, with a backup option (such as mobile data or a pocket Wi-Fi) for outages.



Applications that do not meet these requirements will not be considered.



This Role Is Not For You If



Your experience is mainly YouTube videos, vlogs, weddings, events or corporate videos.

You are looking for a general content creation or social media editing role.

You have not edited ads that were run with paid spend.

You need step-by-step direction on every edit.

You are not comfortable receiving honest feedback and iterating quickly.



What You’ll Do



Edit high-quality video ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube from creative briefs and footage provided by the team, including UGC-style, founder-led, product demo, lifestyle and testimonial ad formats.

Edit TikTok Shop video ads that showcase our products clearly and naturally.

Use strong storytelling and pacing to make every ad engaging from the first second to the CTA.

Create multiple variations of each ad (hooks, intros, CTAs and aspect ratios) for testing.

Turn long-form YouTube and adventure footage, plus B-roll, into short, scroll-stopping ads.

Apply feedback from the media buyer and marketing team to improve the next round of edits.

Suggest fresh editing styles, formats and hook ideas you’ve seen working in DTC ads.

Keep our ad creative library organised, labelled and easy to find.

Work closely with our founders, Head of Marketing and Operations, media buyer and other video editors.



Required Skills and Experience



A strong eye for what makes a video ad work, including hooks, pacing, captions, sound design and clear CTAs.

Strong storytelling skills in short-form video ads.

Expertise in editing with B-roll and creating TikTok Shop ads.

Skilled in motion graphics and animated text overlays for ads.

Able to work from scripts and creative briefs while bringing your own editing ideas.

Experience editing ads for Australian or US brands.

A basic understanding of ad metrics such as hook rate and CTR, and how editing choices affect them.

Advanced skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve.

Fast turnaround without losing quality, and able to manage multiple ad batches each week.

Clear English communication and honest, timely updates.



What We Offer



A full-time, long-term remote role with a growing Australian business.

Creative freedom in how you edit, with a say in the ad ideas we try.

A supportive, honest team culture where your ideas are heard.

Room to grow as our e-commerce brands scale.



How to Apply



To apply, please send the following:



1. A short introduction video



Record a short video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a great fit for this role.



Please upload it to Google Drive, Loom or another platform where we can easily watch it, then include the link in your application.



Important: The video is a required part of the application. This role requires strong attention to detail, clear communication and the ability to follow instructions. Applications without a video will not be considered.



2. Your CV and ads portfolio



Please include your CV, along with:



Your portfolio of paid ads only (links to live ads or an ads reel, not general edits), including at least three Meta video ads you’ve edited. Applications without an ads portfolio will not be reviewed.

The DTC brands you’ve edited ads for and their approximate monthly revenue.

The ad you’re most proud of, with a short note on why you think it worked as an ad (results are a bonus if you have them).

Any TikTok Shop ads you’ve edited, if available.

Your laptop or computer specs (processor, RAM and graphics card).

Your available start date.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview.



To show you’ve read this post, start your application with the words “FDYS Ads”. Applications without this will not be reviewed.

title: Legal Executive Assistant
description:
NOW HIRING - Virtual Executive Assistant (Legal)

Position Details-

Location: 100% Remote (Philippines)

Hours: 40 hours per week

Employment Type: Full-Time, Long-Term

Firm Type: Active U.S. Law Firm (Criminal Defense, Juvenile Defense, CPS and Protective Orders)

Requirement: Prior experience with a U.S. law firm is mandatory!

About The Edgett Law Firm-

The Edgett Law Firm is a well-established, fast-paced criminal and juvenile defense firm based in McKinney, Texas. We primarily serve clients across Collin and Denton Counties and handle cases throughout the DFW Metroplex and the entire State of Texas. Our firm was founded by Scott Edgett, a licensed Texas attorney with 24 years of courtroom experience, and it operates with a White Glove client service standard. Behind every case is a client counting on us to stay on top of every date, deadline, and detail. That is where you come in. We are growing, and we need the right person to keep our operations organized and running smoothly behind the scenes.

Position Overview-

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-driven, and proactive Virtual Executive Assistant to directly support our Director of Operations. This is not a general administrative role. You will manage a high-volume inbox, coordinate schedules, communicate on the Director’s behalf, verify court dates, track case updates, and make sure every piece of client information is where it belongs. You must understand the sensitive and confidential nature of legal work and carry yourself accordingly in a professional environment.

What You Will Do-

• Manage a high-volume inbox, organizing messages by priority and sorting them into items that need a response and items that are for awareness only.

• Schedule calls and meetings as needed, and keep the calendar accurate and up to date.

• Draft and send
s on behalf of the Director of Operations in a professional, polished tone.

• Cross-check court dates from our tracking spreadsheet against the firm calendar, and flag any missing dates or conflicts.

• Prepare and organize case update requests to District Attorney’s Offices, and send them when directed.

• Assist with electronic filing of legal documents under attorney supervision.

• Track calls and enter notes into client files, keeping records accurate and current.

• Handle sensitive and confidential client information with the highest level of discretion.

What We Are Looking For-

• Prior experience as an executive assistant, legal assistant, paralegal, or similar role with a U.S. law firm is required. This is not negotiable.

• Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

• Exceptional attention to detail, especially with dates, names, and case information.

• Ability to manage a heavy workload and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience with case management systems preferred (MyCase or similar).

• Familiarity with court calendars, docketing, or e-filing is a strong plus.

• Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and spreadsheets.

• Understanding of confidentiality and procedural compliance in a legal setting.

• Self-motivated, reliable, and proactive with minimal need for micromanagement.

Tools and Systems You May Work With-

• MyCase or similar legal case management platform

• Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets)

• Microsoft Office Suite

• Texas e-filing system

• GoTo or similar VOIP phone system

• Slack for internal team communication

• Zoom and Google Meet for virtual meetings

• AI-assisted tools to support workflow and communications

Work Schedule and Compensation-

This is a full-time remote position of 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, aligned to U.S. Central Time business hours. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, not just fill a seat.

Compensation will be competitive and discussed based on your experience and qualifications. Long-term stability and growth opportunities are available for the right person.

Why Work With The Edgett Law Firm-

• You will work directly with our Director of Operations and an experienced legal team that values your role and treats you as a true member of the firm.

• This is a long-term opportunity with a firm that is actively growing across multiple locations.

• We have a team culture built on core values, accountability, and treating every client and team member with respect.

• You will gain deep experience inside a U.S. law firm environment that will elevate your professional career.

How to Apply-

To be considered for this position, please send the following:

1. An updated resume or profile with detailed experience and background.

2. A cover letter with a brief introduction explaining why you are the right person for this Executive Assistant position.

3. Any prior employer reviews, references, etc., if available.

4. Your desired compensation for this position.

**Please email ALL of the above information to Tonya[at]edgettlawfirm.com with the subject line “Virtual EA – [Your Name]” for your consideration for this Executive Assistant position with The Edgett Law Firm.

Thank you for your interest in joining our legal team!

title: END-TO-END RECRUITER (REMOTE)
description:

Incomplete applications may not be considered.



Job Overview

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and experienced End-to-End Recruiter to manage the complete recruitment process, from sourcing and interviewing candidates to onboarding, placement, and employee support.



The ideal candidate must be comfortable handling multiple job openings, communicating with candidates and clients, managing recruitment documentation, and coordinating timesheets and payroll-related matters.

1. Recruitment & Sourcing

Review resumes and identify qualified applicants.

Conduct phone screenings and interviews.

2. Background Checks & Onboarding

Collect, review, and submit timesheets.

5. Reporting & Administration

Update recruitment activities in the ATS.

Track interviews, placements, and recruitment progress.

Provide regular reports and updates to management.



Qualifications

At least 2 years of full-cycle recruitment experience.

Experience in staffing, education, healthcare, or related industries preferred.

Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

Experience with candidate sourcing, interviewing, onboarding, and background checks.

Preferred Skills

Experience recruiting for public school districts or educational institutions.

Familiarity with RBTs, Behavioral Technicians, Paraprofessionals, and Classroom Assistants.

Manatal ATS experience is highly preferred.

Primepoint experience is preferred.

Knowledge of payroll, timesheet processing, and employee management.



Work Requirements

Fully remote position.

Reliable primary and backup internet connections.

Quiet and professional home workspace.

Availability to work U.S. business hours.

Flexibility for occasional early morning or evening calls.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

All applicants MUST submit the following:



Updated Resume/CV – Include your relevant recruitment experience.

LinkedIn Profile URL – Provide your updated LinkedIn profile link.

Internet Speed – Indicate your current download and upload speeds in Mbps.

title: Executive Assistant & Business Operations Partner (GoHighLevel Experience Required)
description:
I'm looking for someone wonderful to join me as my right-hand person in the business. I run an online coaching business helping women create a more peaceful relationship with food and their bodies. 



Someone who genuinely enjoys being involved, takes pride in their work, loves creating order out of chaos, and gets excited about finding ways to make things better. Someone who naturally thinks ahead, takes ownership, identifies opportunities for improvement, and can independently manage projects and operations without needing constant direction.



For me, the ideal working relationship is one where I can share an idea, and you are able to figure out what needs to happen to bring it to life. If you notice something isn't working efficiently, I’d love for you to investigate it and come to me with a proposed solution.



You're comfortable taking the lead on things, bringing ideas to the table, and making decisions within your area of responsibility.



>>> What we'll work on together

There will be a nice mix of responsibilities, and the role will evolve as we get to know each other and discover where you can bring the most value.



1) Business Operations & Systems

-Keeping an eye on the day-to-day operations of the business and making sure things are running smoothly.

-Looking for opportunities to simplify, improve, and streamline the way we do things.

-Creating thorough, easy-to-follow SOPs and documenting processes.

-Finding ways to automate or delegate recurring tasks.

-Helping me stay organized and making sure important things don't fall through the cracks.

-Bringing forward ideas and recommendations that could make the business better.



2) Project Management & Execution

-Taking my ideas and helping turn them into actionable plans.

-Breaking projects down into tasks, timelines, and next steps.

-Keeping projects moving and coordinating with other team members or contractors.

-Thinking ahead about what's needed, anticipating potential roadblocks, and following things through to completion.

-Helping me stay focused on the bigger picture while you manage the moving pieces.



3) GoHighLevel / FG Funnels

-Managing and maintaining our CRM, contacts, pipelines, and automations.

-Building and troubleshooting workflows.

-Working with funnels, landing pages, forms, and
 campaigns.

-Keeping our systems organized and functioning properly.

-Identifying opportunities to improve our existing automations and customer journeys.



4) Executive & Client Support

-Helping manage and organize my inbox and communications.

-Responding to client questions and handling follow-ups with warmth and professionalism.

-Coordinating scheduling, reminders, and administrative tasks.

-Monitoring payments and following up on failed payments.

-Thinking about what else you could take off my plate.



5) Podcast Outreach & Marketing Support

-Researching podcast opportunities that align with our brand.

-Creating and managing an organized outreach and follow-up system.

-Coordinating pitches and communications.

- Figuring out what information, ideas, or assets you need from me to make the outreach process successful.



>>> A little about the person I’m hoping to find



More than anything, I'm looking for someone who genuinely enjoys taking ownership of their work.



Someone who:

-Is naturally proactive and enjoys thinking ahead.

-Is resourceful and can figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions.

-Takes initiative and feels comfortable taking the lead.

-Is organized, thorough, and has a great eye for detail.

-Communicates openly, clearly, and proactively.

-Enjoys creating systems and finding better ways of doing things.

-Can take an idea and run with it.

-Brings solutions and recommendations rather than simply presenting problems.

-Takes pride in producing high-quality work.

-Is comfortable sharing their perspective, asking questions, and respectfully challenging ideas when they see a better way.

-Is reliable and follows through on what they say they'll do.



I don't expect you to know everything or have every answer. I do value curiosity, resourcefulness, good judgment, and a willingness to figure things out.



I want someone who thinks alongside me, not someone who needs me to think for them.



>>> Our values

I believe good work and a good working relationship should coexist.

I value:

Playfulness, lightness, and fun.

Empowerment and authenticity.

Well-being, including yours.

Emotional intelligence and vulnerability.

Honesty and openness.

High standards and excellent work.



We work hard, but we don't believe in unnecessary stress, constant urgency, or making things more complicated than they need to be.



>>>Technical requirements:

Proven, hands-on GoHighLevel / FG Funnels experience.

Experience building and managing workflows, automations, funnels, and CRM systems.

Strong project management and SOP documentation skills.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience supporting an online business, preferably a coaching or service-based business.

Comfortable with Google Workspace, ClickUp, Slack, and related tools.



>>> Practical details

Part-time position, approximately 10 hours per week to start.

Flexible working hours, with clear communication and deadlines.

Remote / work from home.

Long-term opportunity to grow together.



>>> Interested? I'd love to hear from you!



Rather than just telling me you're proactive, organized, or a great problem-solver, I'd love to hear a little about how you actually work.



Please answer the following questions:

1. Your GoHighLevel experience

How long have you worked with GoHighLevel / FG Funnels? What have you personally built, managed, or troubleshooted? I'd love to hear about specific projects you've worked on.



2. Tell me about a time you noticed something that could be improved.

Maybe a process that wasn't working well, something that was taking too much time, or an opportunity you noticed that nobody had brought up. What did you notice, and what did you do about it?



3. Tell me about something you've taken ownership of.

Share an example of a project, responsibility, or problem you independently took from start to finish. How did you approach it?



4. When you don't know how to do something, what do you typically do?

I'd love to understand how you approach unfamiliar tasks, research solutions, and work through challenges when you don't have someone guiding you step by step.



5. What does being a great right-hand person mean to you?

What do you think makes someone genuinely valuable to the person they support? I'd love to hear how you've demonstrated this in your own work.



6. What systems or processes have you created?

Tell me about an SOP, workflow, or system you've personally developed that made someone's work or business easier.



7. A little introduction (video, 2 minutes max)

Please attach a short video introducing yourself. Nothing fancy needed. A video recorded on your phone is absolutely perfect!

Tell me a little about who you are, what you enjoy doing, and what excites you about the possibility of working together in this role.

I’d love to get a sense of your personality and the person behind the application. No need to overthink it. Just be yourself!



8. Please let me know your availability and hourly rate as well!



I can’t wait to meet you!

title: AI Video Ad Creator (Higgsfield / Kling) for UK Beauty Brand, Part Time, Skilled at Meta Ads
description:
ABOUT US

Lumelle is a UK hair-protection brand (satin-lined shower caps and XL hair towels) selling through Meta ads, Shopify, Amazon and TikTok Shop. We run a high volume of video ads on
 and Instagram and we want to scale our AI video production.



THE ROLE

You'll turn our scripts and briefs into finished AI video ads for Meta. We write the scripts and supply real product footage. You create the AI scenes, voices and characters, then edit everything into a finished ad.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Create consistent AI characters (e.g. a mum and daughter) and keep them identical across every shot

- Generate dialogue scenes and talking-head clips

- Produce AI voiceovers with consistent voices across shots

- Blend AI scenes with our real product footage

- Edit finished ads: captions, pacing, hooks, music, 9:16 and 4:5 formats

- Make hook variations and refresh our winning ads



VOLUME

We produce a high volume of ads, from full AI dialogue scenes to quick hook variations on our winning ads. Speed matters as much as quality. We'll agree weekly output targets with you after the trial task.



OUR TOOLS

We currently use Higgsfield (including Kling). If you're skilled in other AI video tools such as Veo, Seedance, Sora, Runway, HeyGen or Arcads, we still want to hear from you. Tell us what you use and why. If your workflow produces better ads, we're open to working your way.



MUST HAVE

- Proven hands-on experience with AI video generation tools (portfolio required)

- Experience creating video ads for Meta 
 and Instagram): you understand hooks, sound-off viewing with captions, and 9:16 and 4:5 formats

- Experience keeping AI characters and voices consistent across a video

- Lip-sync experience, and knowing what to do when it looks off

- Strong editing in CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar

- Good written English and reliable communication



NICE TO HAVE

- Higgsfield or Kling experience

- Experience making ads for beauty, skincare or DTC e-commerce brands

- ElevenLabs experience



OUR RULES

- Product shots always use our real footage. Never AI-generate the product.

- AI people are never presented as real customers.

- All work and IP belongs to Lumelle under a written contract.



WHAT WE OFFER

- $600–750 USD per month for 20 hours per week, based on experience

- Performance bonus: $15 for every ad that reaches £100 spend at or under our cost-per-sale target

- We provide the AI tools and credits. You don't need your own subscriptions.

- Flexible hours, long-term work, and room to grow into full time as volume increases



HIRING PROCESS

Shortlisted candidates complete a paid trial task ($25): a 45-second AI dialogue ad using our script and real product footage.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "SATIN CAP" so we know you read this, then answer:

1. Send links to 2–3 AI videos you made yourself, including at least one ad that ran on Meta. For each one, tell us which tools you used and, if you know, how the ad performed.

2. How do you keep a character's face and voice consistent across multiple AI shots?

3. What do you do when AI lip-sync looks wrong?

4. Walk us through your workflow for making an AI video ad, from script to finished edit. Which tools do you use at each step, and why?



Applications without a portfolio, or without the answers above, won't be reviewed.

title: All-Rounder Billing, Bookkeeping and Admin Specialist | Paid Training with US Owners | $700 to $1,000 | Full-Time Remote
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are a US based restoration company (CRDN) looking for a detail oriented all-rounder to support our billing, bookkeeping, and daily operations. This is a role for someone who wants to learn and grow.



You do not need to have all the experience. No one does, and that is what the training is for. Our owners teach you hands on, every day, and you will learn the restoration and insurance side of the business directly from them. If you are detail oriented, eager to learn, and ready to be coached by the people running the company, this job is for you.



Experience in restoration, insurance, or bookkeeping is key, along with great communication.



IMPORTANT: VIDEO MEETINGS REQUIRED

Availability on Teams is a must for training, especially in the first 30 to 60 days. You will be on camera in daily meetings with the owners. If you are not comfortable being on video calls, please do not apply for this position. This must be your only full time job.



ABOUT THE COMPANY

CRDN, a family owned restoration company and part of a national restoration, fire damage, water damage, and contents/textile restoration franchise network





Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Full Time, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern. That is 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time through March 2027, and one hour earlier once the US clocks change.

Position Type: Long term, with room to grow

Compensation: $700 to $1,000/month, based on experience. The client is happy to discuss a higher rate if all qualifications are met.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will be the right hand for the CRDN team. You will keep the books clean, support billing and admin, communicate with adjusters and customers, and help build the systems that keep the company organized. You will be trusted with sensitive financial and business information, so discretion, accuracy, and honesty matter as much as technical skill. When something is unclear or a number doesn't add up, we want you to flag it and ask rather than guess.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Bookkeeping in QuickBooks, including account management and PayPal

- Billing and admin support for CRDN, including reviewing the work of billers and stepping in on jobs that fall behind

- Communicate professionally with insurance adjusters

- Prepare reporting for CRDN

- Manage
 inboxes

- Follow up with customers and support the warehouse manager

- Manage calls and texts in Podium, handle about 75% on your own, and escalate anything that needs higher attention

- Help manage marketing campaigns

- Create and maintain SOP documentation for the company

- Work within EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System)



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- Experience in at least one of these areas: bookkeeping, billing, insurance, or restoration (2+ years preferred)

- Great communication, with clear spoken and written English, comfortable on the phone and on camera

- Strong attention to detail and follow through

- A willingness to learn and take coaching

- Your own working laptop, reliable internet, a backup connection, and a quiet space



PREFERRED (A PLUS, NOT REQUIRED)

- QuickBooks experience

- Xactimate experience

- Podium experience

- Familiarity with EOS

- Marketing campaign experience



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- A detail oriented student of the business who is eager to learn from the owners

- Genuinely positive, hardworking, and coachable

- Good judgment on what to handle yourself and what to escalate

- Trustworthy with confidential financial information

- Reliable, consistent, and looking for a long term relationship, not a short term gig



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS (REQUIRED TO BE CONSIDERED)

To be considered, you MUST

Automations

Forms

Research, test, and implement emerging AI technologies that improve productivity, customer experience, and operational performance.

Repurpose content across multiple platforms to maximize reach and efficiency.

Automate content scheduling, publishing, customer engagement, lead capture, and follow-up sequences using GoHighLevel and other automation platforms.

Stay current on platform updates, social media trends, AI marketing tools, and emerging digital marketing strategies.

Support the development, optimization, and management of e-commerce stores and marketplace operations.

Assist with product listings, inventory workflows, promotional campaigns, and customer experience improvements.

Build systems that streamline marketplace operations and improve operational efficiency.

Integrate marketplace platforms with CRM, automation, inventory, and marketing systems.

Business Strategy & Process Improvement

Recommend AI, automation, and digital marketing strategies that improve productivity and revenue.

Ensure accurate data synchronization and seamless information flow across all connected platforms.

Develop systems that improve customer acquisition, marketing performance, sales processes, reporting, and business intelligence.

Continuously identify opportunities to optimize workflows, reduce operational costs, and improve overall business performance.

Experience with automation platforms such as Zapier, Make.com, GoHighLevel, or similar.

Experience working with APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.

Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL).

Experience managing business social media accounts and digital marketing campaigns.

Understanding of major social media platforms, analytics, scheduling tools, and content strategies.

Experience supporting e-commerce businesses or online marketplaces.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and systems-thinking abilities.

Excellent organizational and time management skills.

Ability to work independently while meeting deadlines.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.



Preferred

Experience designing end-to-end business automation systems.

Background in AI implementation or systems architecture.

Experience integrating multiple SaaS platforms.

Familiarity with Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, Etsy, or similar platforms.

Experience with prompt engineering and AI-assisted content creation.

Experience creating dashboards, reporting systems, and business analytics.

Understanding of SEO, paid advertising, and digital marketing automation is a plus.

Engagement Structure & Work Arrangement

This opportunity follows a task-based gig-work arrangement, not a traditional full-time or part-time employment structure.

Assignments will be provided based on current business requirements and project priorities.

Each assignment will have a defined scope, expected deliverables, and agreed completion timeline.

Work schedules will be flexible, provided that agreed deadlines and deliverables are met.

Additional assignments may be offered based on performance, business needs, and the quality of completed work.

Long-term collaboration may be considered based on consistent performance and ongoing project requirements.



Hiring Process

Our selection process prioritizes demonstrated technical competency and practical execution.

The process includes:

Initial interview or technical assessment, if necessary.

Paid production-based trial assignment involving actual GoHighLevel-related business requirements.

Evaluation based on:

Technical proficiency and platform knowledge.

Accuracy and functionality of configured workflows.

Quality of automation and system integrations.

Problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities.

Attention to detail.

Timeliness and adherence to agreed deadlines.

Documentation and communication.

Recurring Opportunities: Potential for regular CRM maintenance, automation development, and marketing optimization assignments.

Multi-Business Exposure: Opportunities to work on GoHighLevel systems and automation projects across multiple businesses.

Technical Development: Exposure to CRM architecture, marketing automation, API integrations, AI-powered workflows, and e-commerce systems.

Independent Work Environment: Flexibility to manage your approach and working schedule while meeting agreed deadlines and project requirements.

Performance-Based Growth: Opportunities to handle more complex technical projects and higher-value assignments as your expertise develops.



About the Company

We are building a multi-business digital ecosystem powered by AI, automation, scalable operational systems, digital marketing, and intelligent business processes. Our mission is to create an integrated infrastructure that connects multiple companies through automation, technology, and revenue-driven execution.

We value professionals who are proactive, systems-oriented, resourceful, execution-focused, and committed to building long-term solutions that create measurable business impact.

title: Part-Time Sales Setter for Australian Company: Hourly + Commission
description:
About us



Wonderful Stay is a Australia-based Airbnb Management company. We currently have 30+ units, 3 years operating and 1,000+ Review. Potential customers enquire with us every day; your job is to be the first voice they hear.



The role



You will be our Lead Triage Specialist (appointment setter). When a lead enquires, you call them back fast, ideally within 15 minutes, qualify them against our criteria, and book the good ones onto a call with our Acquisition Manager. You are not doing cold calls and you are not closing deals; every person you speak to has already asked us to contact them. You follow a proven, word-for-word call script and a simple follow-up process (confirmation text,
 templates, calendar invite). Full training provided.



Day to day, you will:



* Call new inbound leads within minutes of their enquiry



* Run a structured qualification call (roughly 10 minutes) covering their situation, motivation, goals and timeline



* Book qualified leads into our Acquisition Manager's calendar, with all decision-makers confirmed for the call



* Send confirmation texts/WhatsApps and templated
s straight after each booking



* Follow up with leads who did not answer, via calls, text and
 sequences



* Keep simple notes on every lead so nothing slips through the cracks





Hours and pay



* Part-time and flexible; hours flex with lead flow rather than a fixed shift



* You must be available and reachable during agreed daytime windows Australian business hours; 9 am - 12 pm, so leads get called back within 15 minutes.



* Paid hourly (state your rate or invite proposals) plus commission for every booked call that shows up, so the better you are, the more you earn



You are a great fit if you:



* Speak fluent, clear, confident English on the phone



* Are comfortable making phone calls and can follow a script while still sounding natural and human



* Are organised and reliable; call-backs happen at the exact time promised, follow-ups always get sent



* Have a quiet space to take calls, a decent headset/phone and stable internet



* Are coachable; we will train you on the script, review your calls and help you improve



* Bonus (not required): any experience in sales, customer service, telesales, promotions, hospitality or fundraising



What you get



* Hourly pay plus uncapped commission on attended booked calls



* A proven script and full training; you are set up to win from day one



* Real sales experience with a growing Australian company, great on any CV



* Flexible hours



*The opportunity to grow with us as we scale





How to apply



So we know you have read this far, start your proposal with the word AIRBNB, then answer these three:





Tell us about yourself and your current situation (e.g. which university, what you study)



In 2 or 3 sentences, why do you think you would be good on the phone with Australian customers?





A 30 to 60 second voice note or audio recording of you reading this line as if you were on a real call: "Hey, is that Nino? Great, it's (your name) from Wonderful Stay. You just enquired about Airbnb Management Service so I wanted to give you a quick call to understand your situation and what you're looking to do. Do you have 2 minutes now?" (Attach it to your proposal; applications without audio will not be shortlisted.)



Shortlisted candidates will do a short role-play call with us before we hire.
